thalinenho ilvhski winuhsvlhv kekwani wuyvlhe'i; tunotsalhotsenho kalhtsote aya'v'i.
khilakwono iyvtv unitsathi' tunilawitsolhe'i, nahski iyuhsti vlha yutlatnvte, vtla hnskwo kalohihstiyulhti; khanohetvnho tulhtsitonhele'i.
kvwaluhtselenho khilo iyuhsti ulvtalv'ski aninehe'ihv nahski nvhki iyanitv kvwhanholhe'i.
uninulvnvhno katokv na'v uniluhihstiyi aninenulhv iyuhsti i unvnehse nanhahaya'v'i; unvnehsvnhohe elati nunvnele atsehsto nanha hulvtalv'vhski kanhvkv'i.
tsihsanho ukohv unohiyusv'ihi hi'a nuwehsele ulvtalvski, ayatsi, tsahskanvtsv etsatoliki.
ahsenho nanhahani'ne khilo iyunahsti tinowhelihskihi hi'a nuhste anatanvhthehske totsunatanhtv'i,
katonho hi'a ahskaya hi'a nikaweha iahsotlv'ihstiha?  kako yeli ahskanvtsv kvwatatolihsti, sakwokwo uwahsv, nahski unelanvhi?
khilakwonho' iyvtv tsihsa tsutanhtv utolehohs nuhstv anatanhthehskv totsunatanhtv'i, hi'a ntuwehsele'i; katonho nahski hi'a ni'uhsti itsatanhtheha totitsatanhthv'i?
kato uhsti utli' ahitiyu?  tsiko hi'a yinakawehse ulvtalvski, tsahskanvtsv etsatolikivi hi'akhe yinakaweha, thalehvka, ale hinaki tsatsehsto, ale heta?
ahsenho itsatolehohihstiyi yvwi uwetsi uhi kvwatatolihsti kesv ahskanvtsv'i anhi' elohi (hi'a nuwehsele ulvtalvski,)
kvyohseha, thalehvka, ale hinaki tsatsehsto, ale titsenvhsv whilohi.

khilakwonho iyvt tulenhe'i, unehsvnho atsehsto, unukotse nikatv anikhthahv'i; nahski iyuhsti nikatv unihskwanikohse'i v ale unelhanvhi unilvkwohthane hi'a nuniwehse'i; vlha ilvhiyu nahski iyuhsti yokikoho'i.
thalinenho unukotse vtali' ulhti uwetole'i; ale nikatv unitsathi wkvwaluhtsele'i, ale nahski tuweyonhe'i.
a'ihsvnho, liwi elikwi uwetsi ukohe uwolhe ayelhi atelv akihstiyi, ale hi'a nuwehsele'i, skihstawatuka. v tulenhvnho uhstawatvhse'i.

hi'anho nulhsthane'i, nahski [tsisa] kanhvhkv alhstayvhvhskv nahski kanelv'i, unitsathe atelv anikihsitohi ale anihskana itsulaha taninhvke tsihsa' ale kvwahstawatitohi; unitsatheyhenho, ale kvwhstawatitohe'i.

tinowelihskinho ale anikwalihsi kvwakohv itsulaha analihstayvhvhskv atel anikihsitohi ale anihskana, hi'a nituniwehsele kvwhstawatitohi, katonho itsulaha tsanalhstayvhvhska ale itsulaha tsanatithahska atelv anikihsitohi ale anihskana'i.

tsihsanho nahski uthvkanv hi'a ntuwehsele'i, nahski nitunitlvkvna vlha utulhti yinunalhstanheho titanhvwihski v tsunitlvkihskini; vtla unatanhthi yititsiyanvhilhv, anihskanahskini tunatanvhthv tsuninetliyvhstiyi.

tsaninho kvhwstawatitohi ale anikwalihs kvwnihstawatitohi amatli anvhski kehse'i; uniluhtsenho ale hi'a nikvwawehsele'i, katonho tsani' kvhwstawatitohi, al anikwalihsi kvwanihstawatitohi amatli tsanvhsko'i, nihino kehtsstawatitoh amalhi nanvhskvna tsikehso'i?
tsihsanho hi'a nituwehsele'i, tsiko tekekatsvhstihskv anikhthahi yeli amalhi yanvna atehsvhvhski unhelatitohv ikohitv? i ikohitv atehsvhski unhelatitohv, vlha yeli amalhi yvkvnvna.
tvhskwalvhihskini nahiyu ketsiyanv'ehtiyi atehsvhvhski, nahiyuno nhahkwo amalhi tvnvnhi.
vlha ale khilo uwethi anhuwo' itse akvhalvtv yikahlstlvtihsko'i, itseyhenho akvhalvtv kalhstlvthanvhi yvkatsakalvtota uwethi, nahskino utatsatelvhv utli ekwohiyu yinvkalhsta.

vlha ale khilo itse kikake-atithahsti tsuwethi tihsutlvhtv yitatlihstihsko'i; itseyhenho kikke-atethahst yitokatsakalv tihsutlvhtv, ale kikake-atithahsti yatsewoki v ale tihsulhtv yitayoki; itsehskini kikake-atithahsti, titse tihsutlvhtv titlihstohti kehso'i.
hi'anho nulhsthane'i, nahski tlokehsi utsalehsti tawhihsv ulose unatotakwahskv ika; kvwhstawatitohinho unalenvhe ana'ihsv unihskutehsthanvhse utsalehsti.
anikwalihsinho hi'a nikvwawehsele'i, kvnhiyukwo, katonho unatotakwahskv ika nituyukhthvna kehsv nanatvneha.
hi'ahno nituwehsele'i, lhahsko yitsikoliye tewi nutvnelv tsunikvhsehe iyu'i ale akonu tsuyohsihske'i, uwahsv, ale nahski tsanehe'i?

nahski unelhanvhi utseli atanelv tsuyvlhe nahiyu tsehe ekwayita nukvwiyuhsv atsilv-kelhohi, ale tsuke akatohti katu, nahski kvkihsti nikehsvna tsikehse atsilvanelhohi unvhsv, ale nahskwo tsitunhele nahski anehi.
ale hi'a nituwehsele'i, unatotakwahskv utolhvnhe yvwi nvtikalhstohtihske'i; vlhanho unatotakwahskv' yintikalhstohtihske yvwi yikekolhvnhe'i.
nahski iyuhsti nahskwo yvwi uwetsi unatotakwahskv ukvwiyuhi.
thalinenho wuyvlhe tikalawihstiyihv nanhahno' etohe ahskaya uwoyeni uwahihselvhi.
kvwayawihsenho unatulihske unatolehohihstiyi kvwatanhvwoti kehsv' unatotakwahskv ikahv nahski kvwhye'ilitahstiyi.
hi'ano nuwehsele ahskaya uwoyeni uwa'ihselvhi i ayelhi halehvka.

ale tsiluhslimi, ale itomiyi v ale tsotani ihskhonititlv; ale taya ale satoni na'v tinehi, utsathi anikotiyu, nahski unathvkanv nika'v uhskwanikhti tulvwhihstanelv, kvwaluhtshele'i.
tunhetselenho kvhwstawtitohiav nahski tsiyu ukhthitihstiyi, unhitsathi kehsv iyuhsti, nahski kvwanenulahstohtiyi nikehsvna.
unitsatheyhenho tunvwane'i; nahski' iyuhsti kvwanenulahstihske kvwanolhihstohtiyi unatulihske'i, nikatv kohuhsti tinalhstihski.

unhahluhsenho otalv'i, ale tuyhanvhe nahski utulihskv' tsuyhnvhtiyi; ale kvwaluhtsehe'i.

ale tsimi tsekwiti uwetsi, ale tsani tsimi tinatanhvlhi; ale nahski kwo'anatsi tuwo'e'ivi nahski ayvtakwalohski tsuwetsi katka;
ale eniti, ale kwiliki, ale kwtlami, ale matu, ale tami v ale tsimi elikwi uwetsi, ale tatiya v aleh sawani akenaniti,
ale tsutahsi ihskalati, nahskivhskwo tsulonuhelhe'i i atanelvnho wunilose'i.
