tinowhelihskinho tsiluhslimi ntayunilohsvhi v hi'a naniwehske'i v kwelitsikwa uweha v ale ukvwiyuhi anihskina unatselika khtiha tekanukowihska anihskina.
nahskino wituyhanvhv i hi'a ntuwehsele tulhilohstanele'i, kato yikalhstohta hsetani yikanukowa setani?
iyu ale ayelhi kolhvhsv thali yinuta'a, uwahsvkwo yatatlutiha, vlha yeli yinikvwahstikwo nahski ayelhi kolhvsv'i.
iyu ale sitanelv kehsv tha'li yinuta'a, uwahsvkwo yatatlutiha v nahskih sitanelv kehsv' vlha yeli yinikvwahstikwo.
iyu aleh setani yitulenhv uwahsv' yitutakhthilenv i ale thali yinuta'a, vtla yeli ynikvwhstikwo, yiwhahsthakwohskini' ehv'i.
vtla khilo ulhinikitv ahskaya kanelv yvkvyvha, ale yvkvwonv unhahai, khvni ikvyi yulhvlv nahski ulhinikitv ahskayaha khila nhahkwo yawonv kanelv unhahai.
utohiyuhya itsvyohseha, nika'v ahskanv'ihsti kehsv, kaketsitolihstikwo kehsehsti yvwi tsunetsi, ale ahsotlv'ihstohti kehsv', nika'v kvwanihsotlv'ihstohti kehsv'i;
khilohskini kalvkwtiyu atanto ahsotlv'ihstihskehsti, vlha ilvhiyu kyetsitolihsti yikehsehsti v tikayekukotantikwohskini winahsthvna uhstvtihstiyi;
nvtikalhstohtihske'i, kataha atanhto' uya'a, unatvnhv'i.
nhahkwonho kvwaluhtsele analhinvtli, ale utsi, ale toyititlv tanitoke v unatanvhse wikvwhayanihske'i.
unitsathino anine kvwatalhuwhihste'i v hi'anho nikvwawehsele'i, kvniyukwo, tsatsi' ale itsalhinvtli toyititlv tiketsayoha.
tunhetselenho hi'a nuwehse'i, kako hetsi, hale otsalhinvtli?
kvwathuwitvnho tukhanhahnitolv uwolhv na'v ani'ni tukhanha'nv hi'a nuwehse'i; khvnhiyukwo etsi, ale otsalhinvtli?
khiloyhenho unelhanvhi utulihskv natvnehehsti, nahski tsohstatanhvlhi, ale vkito, ale etsi.
thalinenho ulenvhe tuteyone' vtalulhtim' unitsathinho kvwatalhuwhihsthane'i, nahski iyuhsti tsiyuhi utsane'i i ale vtali athalv uwenhe'i i nikatvnho unitsathi kehsv vtaluhlti toyi kehsv anitona'e'i.
ale utsathe tsutalenhvtv tuweyhonhe tulhilohstanele'i'i ale hi'a nituwehsele' tateyohvhskv'i,
itsathvtahsta; kvnhiyukwo, awhihski uwhihsvse'i;
hiano nulhsthane awhihskv'i, nahski ikatv nvnohulhti ulakeytvtse'i, tsihskwanho kalvlo'i aninohiitohi uniluhtse ale unikonhe'i.
ikatvnho nvyohi kehsv ulakyatvtse'i, nanhahkayolhiyu kehsv kata'v ale khilakwo iyvtv ti'ulhiyene'i v nvtikalihstohtihske hsakeiyu kehsv kata;
ahsenho nvto ika-ehi tsukhalvtsv uleyvhse'i; ale nitunhahstetlvna kehsv iyuhstihs unhahskvtsekwo.
ikatvnho anukalhvhi ulakeytvtse'iyi anukalhvnho tsuthvhse'i, ale unenulahsthane'i, ale nunanukowhihsvna kehse ukhtha.
ikatvnho ohsv katohi ulakeytvtse'i, ale ulhiyenhe'i v ale athvhske'i, ale khanehkwoke'i, ale ukhthathane'i, ikatv tso'ahskohi iyuwakhti, ikatvnho hsutalihskohi, ikatvnho hskohitskwi.
hi'ano ntuwehsele'i, khilo tekalilkehsti uthvkotiyi, wahthvkvka.
uwahsvnho kehsi, nahski kvwahstawatiteki ale thalatu iyanitv kvwahthvtvnhe kathkv nahski tahtlilohstv'i.
hiano ntuwehsele'i.  nihi etsinelv itsolhihstiyi utelitv kehsv unelhanvhi ukvwiyuh kesv'i; navhskini toyititlv anetohi hi'a nahski nikatv tekekatlilohstaneho'i;

nahski anikowhahthihskv unikowhahthvhtiyi, ale kvwanatolehohihsti nikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi; ale anathvkihskv unathvkotiyihv ale kvwanolhihsti nikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi; nahski tsunatanetliyv'etiyi nikehsvna tunatanhthv'i ale unihskanvtsv kaketsinehtiy nikehsvna.
ale hi'a nituwehsele'i, lhahsko yitsolhka hiha nahski talhilohstv'i?  katonho yikalhstohta yitetsolhki nikatv tatlilohstv'i?
nahski awhihski khanohetv awhihsko'i.
hi'anho nhski nvnohuhlti nanhahkhanohetv tsiketsiwihsele'i; nhahakwonho anahthvkvka v ahskina kaluhko khilakwo iyvtv, ale akihsko khanohetv tsuninawiyi awhihsvhi.
hianho nahski nahskwo nvyohi tsiketsiwihsele'ivi nahski nhahkwo khanohetv anahthvkvka khilakwo iyvtv unalihelitsvhi tanatanilvko'i;
ale' vlha yitunnhahstetlo'i, lhekakwohskini tanikhanhahwateko'i; nhahkwonh, akilhiya ale uteyhahtoti alhiyiloka khanohetv tvlhiyilvhsta, khilakwo iyvtv tunotehiho'i.
ale hi'a anukalhvhi tsiketsiwhihsele'i; nahski hi'a khanohetv tsanathvkihsko'i,
uwelihihstinho elohi ehi, ale kenhv'ihsti kehsv utalitahsti kehsv'i v ale tsutalenhvtv kohuhsti atulhti kesv, aniyvhihv aninenulhahstihsko khanohetv, ale nahski nakhthathvhskvnakwo kehso'i.
hianho nahski ohsv katohi tsiketsiwihsele'i; nahski nthvkihski khanohetvvv ale tinatanilvki, ale anikhthathvhskiav ikatv tso'ahskohi iyuwakti, ikatvnho hsutalhskohi i ikatvnho' ahskohitskwi.
hi'ano ntuwehsele'i, atsvhstohtihsko aninohiho alhilohsti kakhahv hawinititlv unikhohtiyi v ale kanilhvwikwo?  vlhanho unikhohtiyi atsvhstohti kakhohtiyi?
vtlayheno kohuhsti ykvhskalha nhski kvnikehsv ikvnhti nikehsvna; vlhah ale kohuhsti utelitv yinikvnho, nahski' ahse khvnikehsv iyulhstohti nikehsvna.
khilo tekalihlkehsti utvkotiyi wahthvkvka.
hi'anho nituwehsele'i, itseyhthahehsti nuhstv itsatvkihskv'i; nuhstv itsatalhilosvhv, naskiya etsalnalheti kehsesti; nihino itsathkiski' ehtsinkwoheti etsnti kessti.
khilohyeno uhehsti, nahski atsineti kehsehsti; khilonho nuhvna kehsehsti, nahski atshikisvti kehsehsti nahskwo uhv'i.
hi'anho nuwehse'i, unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo khilo ahskaya ukhtha' yuwhihsv katohi;
ale yulhvnhv, ale yatitiha tikvwkitstivi ale ukhtha yulhiyenhv, ale yuthvhsv, nulhstohthanv nutolehohsvna.
katohihyeno uwahsvkwo kananukowhihsko ukhthahthanvhi; ikvyiyi kesv ukalokv, nhahkwonho uhskutathv'i, onhinho ukhalitsvhi ukhthathv uhskutathv'i.
nhahkwono akhthvnaki khilakwo iyvtv ahskutehsko'i, ahskutehstiyhyeno ulhiyilolho'i.
hanho nuwehse'i, kato totatatselhahsthani unelhanvhi ukvwiyhi kehsv'i?  katokhe talhilohstv' totatalhilohsthani?
atsilv-ukhtha' nahskiya'i, nahski katohi tsawhihso'iai tsiwutakonathti uhstikhiyu ehskakwo nika'v uhkatha katohi tahatv'i.

ahsenho awhihsvhi tsikehso'i v tithvhsko'i, ale' utli' ekwohiyu nikalhstihsko' ehskakwo nika'v uyenhaha'v'i, ale tsekwohiyu tayilhvhsko'i; ale tsihskwa utlatnvtv aninohilitohi yelikwo utawatihstv hawinititlv anahatihsko'i.
nahski nuwehse utsathe tulhilohstanele'i i khanohetv tulhtsitonhele'i v nahski yeli kvwnthvkoti' nikalhstihskv'i.
nitalhilohstanehvnahskini vlha yituwonhthane'i i unvhsvnho kehse'i, nikatv nahski' tuwohsihsanele kvhwstawatitohi.
nahiyukwonho ika, uhsv nulhsthanv, hi'a nituwehsele'i, titihsohki skhona witilohi.
tuniyhelihihsthanvnho unitsathi' nvwatvnhekwo tsiyuhi utsa'v kvwahthinhawitvhe'i i ale nahskwo nitikvwatale tsusti tsiyu unalikowhatihse'i.
utsathinho uhyi'lolhe unole, ale tahlstilhanekv tsiyuhi atlike'i, ale nhahkwo akhaliwohi kehse'i.
tsiyuhnho onhititlv utsae kalhihe'i, aksto ukuhsta'e'ivv kvwayehsthanenho, ale hi'a nikvwawehsele'i, thateyhohvhski, tlahsk kohuhsti yeliha tsvtayotsatsvnhi?
tulenhenho, unole uhskatse'i, ale hi'a nuwehsele vtali, thokwo; utatshinahstvhi nhahlhsta.  kanolvhskv'nho uhsulkotse'i, ale utsathi utatsinahstvhi nulhsthane'i.
hiano ntuwehsele'i, katonho nitsihskasvnha?  kato tikalhstohti nitsohiyuhsvna iki?
utsathinho unihskale'i, ale hi'a nitunatawehsele'i i kato uhsti hi'a ahskaya, nahskwoyhenho' unole ale vtali ikvwohiyuhvhska.
ihskhontitlvnho vtali wuni'luhtse aniketeli unatselikohi.
tsiyuhinho utsa'ihsv khilakwo iyvtv tutlohse' ahskaya tatanihsahv nvtayulohsvhi kataha atanhto uya'i,
nahski tatanihsahvkwo ehe'i i vlha ale nahskwo tsutatesvtv kvhti khilo kvwalhvhsti yikehse'i.
yanokiyuhyenho tsatsinvlholhvhi kehse'i v ale tsutatehsvtv tsakalhvhsthanvhi kehse'iai tsutatehsvtvnho takalhske'i, ale tikanvlhohsti tahskwalhske'iav vlha ale khilo kvwatanhthihsohti yikehse'i.
ale nikohilv v svnoyi ale ika v katuhsi' ale tatanihsahv'i'i uwelhuhke'i, ale nvya kvhti atayhelhohe'i.
ahsenho invhiyu wukohv tsihsaai tuhskwahlthane ale utatolihstanele'i,
ale ahstaya uwelhunhe hi'a nuwehse'i; kato tikinatatvtohti nihi tsihsahsv wahsthv kalvlatiyu' ehi unelanvhi uwetsi?ai kvnhetseha, unelhanvhi kvnhe'ihstaneha, nahski hskikilhiyo'ihstohtiyi nikehsvna.
hayn nuwehsele'i v ehinuko'i nahski na ahskaya, nihi hikataha atanhto.
uthvtvnhenho, kato tetsato'vtohi uwohsele'i. v hi'anho nuwehsele'i, suntalhki takwato'v; okitsathayhenho.
ale utsathi' uhstiyethaneh nanhahkehsv tsunukowhihstiyi nikehsvna kehsv'i.
nanhhanho otalulhti unitsathi sunatalhki hsihkwa analhstayvnitohe'i.
nikatvnho anihskina kvwahstiyethane hi'a naniwehske'i, unelaki sihkwa tinetohv wotsi'lohi v nahski witotsiyvhsi.

kilakwono' iyvtv tsihsa tulhskoltanele'i.  tikatahanho titanhto uninukotsv, sihkwa wituniyvsele'i; sunatatlkinho unanelukihse unikhso'ahse kanelhuhki kehsv' vtali wunahlthatinvhse'i, (tha'li iyakayvli iyvtv nani'e'i,) ale vtali tunikvtse'i.
tinikhthiyanho unalihse'i, ale katuhv wuninhonhe'i, ale iyvtv tanewatihsv'i.  uninukotsenho unakhthanhvhse nahski nulhsthanv'i.
tsihsanho kvwaluhtshele'i, ale kvwakohe nahski' ahnskina kvwayvlhvhi, nahski sunatalhki kvwayvlhvhi, uwolhi, ale tunhuwe'i, ale thohi utanvhthe'i; ale anihska'ihe'i.
nahskinho unikohvhi, kvwanhnonhele nulhstanhelv anihskina kvwayvlhvhi, ale nahskwoh sihkwa nunalhstanhelv'i.
ale unalenvhe kvwahthayohsele' utanvhstiyi unatselikohi.
tsiyuhinho utsanv' nahski anihskina kvwayvlhvhi uhthayohsele unelaki uwelihsetiyi uhstawatitahstiyi.
ahsenho' vlha yuhlskoltanelei tsihsa, hi'akwohskini nuwehsele'i, tsihena titsenvhsv kohuhsti titsvnha tinehv'i, ale withinhohvhsi nika'v uhskwanikhti ukvwiyuhi nitsatvnhelv'i, ale tsatolitsv'i.
unhikihsenho, ale ulenvhe tunotsalhane ahskohi' ikatukiyi, nika'v uhskwanikhti tsihsa nutvnhelv'i; hale nikatv yvwi unihskwanikohse'i.
tsihsanho thaline tsiyuhi to'uwehsohtsv ihskhona whi'uluhtsv, unitsathi yvwi kvwatatluwhihsthane'i; ale vtali ulhti etohe'i.
ale kvnhiyukwo ulutse khilo' iyuhsti nukvwihysateki tikalawi'ihstiyi, tsela tsuto'itv; ukohvnho [tsihsa] tulahskv utanvne'i,
ale utsathi uhstiyethane'i, hia nuwese'i; akwetsi akeyhutsa nhahkwo ayohuhska; ahsenho inena, hiyahsihthatvha, nahski utiwhihstiyiai kvnhehstinho.
unenvhsenho; ale unitsathe yvwi kvwahstawatvse'i, ale kvwanenulahstihske'i.
khilono iyuhsti akeyhv thalatu tsutethiyvtv kvwatalenvtv kikv uwenv'ehi,
ale anikotiyu anikanakhthi utsathi kvwakilhvnhvhiyikese'i, ale kohuhsti uhv nikatv uhsvnhi kese akhyihskv'i, ahsenho vlha ohsiyu yinulhstanhehe'i, khanehkwokekwohskini utlvkv'i;
nahski uthvkanv tsihsa atsinohehskv'i, onhititlv unvthitv nunatvnhv uluhihsthane, ale uhsvnhile unhuwv'i.
hiayhenho nuwehse'i, tsunhuwokwo nahskwo yitakwsvnhilv, yakwatiwhi.
khilakwono' iyvtv kikv uwenv'ehv uyohihsthane'i; utolehohsenho ayelv utiwhsv nahski utlvkv'i.
tsihsanho kilakwo iyvtv utolehohsv uwahsv kesv utanhvwoti kehsv unukotsv'i, ukhthahvhse nanhahunvthitv anitona'v'i, ale hi'a nuwehse'i, kako tahsvnhka tikwanhuwo?
kvhwstawatitohinho hi'a nikvwawehsele'i, tehkikowhahthiha unitsathi ketsanenulahstihskv, tsikonho kako akwahsvnhka' ihatiha?
kvwathuwhitvnho ukhthenole ukowathvhtiyi nahski hi'a iyutvnelvhi.
nahskinho akeyhv ahska'ihe ale uwenawihske'i, akhthahe' nulhstanhelv'i, uluhtse ale elati utanvnele'i, ale nikatv tuyukhtv unonhele'i.
hi'ano nuwehsele'i, akwetsi, tsohiyuhsv tsatiwhihsta; nvwhthohiyatv tsihena v ale tsatiwhsvhi kehsehsti tstlvkv'i.
ahsikwo khaneke'i, nukvwiyuhsateki tikalawi'ihstiyi kanelv nvtayunatalenhvhi uniluhtse hi'a nuniwehse'i, uyohuhsv tsetsi; katonho' ahsikwo ihiyateyahthohtiha titeyohvhski?
uthvkanvkwonho tsisa nuhstv uniwonihsv'i a hi'a nuwehsele nukvwiyuhsateki tikalawi'ihstiyi, lhehsti yhihska'ihehsti, tsohiyuhsehstikwo.
vlha ale khilo' yulhskohltanele kvwhstawatvhstiyi, kwita, ale tsimi, ale tsani tsimi tinatanvlhi unvhsv.
uluhtsenho kanelv nukvwiyuhsateki tikalawi'ihstiyi, ale tukahe unatahsuyetv yvwi, ale' utsathi tanatloyhihv ale taniyvhkv'i.
uyelhhno hi'a nituwehsele'i, katonho itsatanoyhvlhihstiha, ale totsatlohyiha?  vlha yuyohuhsv akeyhutsa, kalhihakwohskini.
ikvwatotlvhthanekwon.  nikatvnho tunukowhihsnv, hi'a nahsk akeyhutsa utota ale utsi ale nahski anehi tuthinhvhse, ale wuyvlhe nanhahakeyhutsa tisonv'i.
uwoyhanehsvnho akeyhutsa, hi'a nuwehsele'i, thalita kumi; nahski anhelhthanvhi hi'a nuhsti katka; hikeyhutsa, kvyoseha, thalehvka.
khilakwono iyvtv akeyhutsa tulenhe'i, ale uwetole'i; thalatuyhenho iyutethiyvtv kehse'i.  utsathanvhinho unihskwanikohse'i.
ulhinikitvnho tunetsel tunvhstatele khilo utolehohihstiy nahski; ale unhetsekohuhsti uhlstayvhti uninhehtiyi.
unukotsenho nanhahniav ale uwahsv utselikohi wuluhtse'i; kvwahstawatitohinho kvwahstawatvhse'i.

unatotakwahskvnho ulhiyelolhv, ulenvhe tuteyhonhe tikalawi'ihstiy; unitsathinho kvwatvhknelv unihskwanikohse'i, hi'a naniwehske'i, hatlv akiha hi'a ahskaya hi'a nahski ikvwatvnhti tsiki?  ale kato uhsti' akhthohihsti nahski atsinelvhi tsiki, nahski iyuhsti uhskwanikhti tsitulvwhihstaneha?
tlahsko nahski hi'a tinhehskehski yiki, meli uwetsi, tsimi, ale tsohsi, ale tsuta, ale hsawani analinvtli? v ale tsuto tlahsko anhi yikekatahsuya?  vkvwhsonvtselvkinho.
tsihsanho hi'a nituwehsele'i; atolehohski vlha natsilvkwotvna yikehso'iav utselikohihskininonv uwahsv, ale tsuyvwi anehv'i, ale uwahsv kanelv'i.
ale nnhhavtla kohuhsti uhskwanikhti tikvwalvwhihsthanhti yikese'i, uwahsvhskininonv ilvhski iyanitv tsunitlvk tuhsihthatv ale tunhvwanv'i.
ale uhskwanikohse nanohiyuhvhskvna kehsv'i.  ale uwetole uthuwhitv tekatuwhatihsv'i tateyhohvhske'i.
tha'latunhoh iyanitv wituyanvhe'i v ale tunhvhsitole thaliha tsulikonhvtv, ale tulhskohltanele tsuninukowhihstiyi tikataha titanhto;
ale tunhetsele nahski kohuhsti uniyhvhstiyi nikehsvna unalhstelhtohti anhetohv'i, atolanv'hsti uwahsv v vlha tekalhti i ale katu, ale vtsayi tunatatlohv'i;
tsunalahsulhtiyihskinihv ale lhehsti tha'li yititsanhuwohskehsti.
al hia ntuwehsele'i, atanelv ilvhtlv itsiyvhihehsti, nanhahkwo itsanv'vhskehsti khvnhi vtsanhiki nanhahni.

ale khilo nititsatanilvkvna ale nitsathvtahstanehvna ikehsehsti, nhahkwo nanhahitsanhikihskehsti, titsalahsihteni khohstu tetsinvkotihskehsti, nahski kohiyuhtihski unatlutihski.  utohiyuhya hi nitsvwehsheha, ehskakwo iki unikilhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti hsotami v ale komali, tikukhthohtiyi ika kehsehsti, utlihiyu nanhahkatuhv'i.
uninukotsenho, wunalhtsitonhe nahski yvwi ahse tsuninetliyvhsti kehsv tunatanvhthv'i.
unitsathinho tuninukowhise anihskinavi ale ko'i tunilonethane unitsathi tsunitlvki, ale tuninvwane'i.

elotnho ukvwiyuhi uthvkane nahski atsinohehskv'i; tunotsahlohtsehyenho nahski tuto'v'i; ale hi nuwehse elotv, tsani titawohski talehihsa uyohuhshv'ivi ale nahski nvtikalhstohtiha uhskwanikhti thsiteulvwhihstaneha.
ikatvnho hi'a naniwehske'i, ilaya hi'a i i ikatvnho hi'a naniwehske'i i atolehohski hi'a, ale khilo anatolehohski kehsv nahskiya'i.
elotvhskini uthvkanv, hia nuwehse'i; tsani hi'a, nahski ayv tsitsihskutehsvki; nahski tulehihsanhv uyohuhsv'i.
elotvyhenho uwahsv utanvhsvhi kese wuniyvhvhi kehse tsani, ale titahstutiyi ulhvlvhi kese'iai ahstvtihstihske elotihsi v unhvlhi' kwiliki utali'i; nahskiyeno atayhehe'i.
tsaniyenho hi'a iyuwehselvhi kehse elotv, vlha yituyukhti etsanhvlhi utali'i tsatayheha.
nahski iyuhsti elotihsi' ahskake [tsani] ale yulhe'i; ahsenho vlha nahski ikvwatvhnti yikese'i.

elotyenho ulvkwtiyu kehse tsani, akhthahehyenho utanhthiyu ale nahskanhvna kehsv ahskaya, ale ukhsayhstiyu kehse'i v nahskino uthvkanv [alhtsitohvhskv soi utsathe tulvwhihstanele'i, ale ulhelitsvh athvtahstanehe'i.
ahitvnho nahski ikvtvnhti kehsv uhskwalvhv, nahski elotv utenv iyu ika utvnv'ihsthane kvwalhstayvnanehtiyi tsutseli unikvwiyuhi, ale anihskayekvhsta, ale tikekanelhti kelili anehi,
nahskinho elotisi uwetsi athv uyvlhilv, ale ulhskihsv, ale elotv ale nahski itsulaha aninitlahta'i ohsiyu unyelvnhvvh ukvwiyuhi hi'a nuwehsele athv, skithayosi iyuhstikwo helihskv'i, takvnelinho.
uhselitanelenho [hia nuwehse'i,] iyuhstikwo helihskv skithayohsi, takvnelinho, nahskwo ayelhi iyvtv yiki nanhahakikvwiyuhi kesv'i.
unukotsvnho hi'a winuwehsele utsi, kato tatsithayolhi?  hiano nuwehsele'i, tsani titawohski ahskholi.
ikvwenvtvkwonho ulhihsti uyvlhilhe ukvwiyuhi aya'v'i, ale uthayole hi'a nuwehse'i, akwatuli khilakwo iyvtv hskinehtiyi v athelitokihi, tsani titawohski uhsko.
ukvwiyuhnho utsathi lhakw uyelvnhe'i; ahsenho uhselithanv'i, ale nahski itsulaha unanhtlatnvhi nvtsulhstohthane, vlha kvwakeyuhtohti yikese'i.
khilakwohno iyvtv ukvwiyuhi unvhse ayahwski v ale unhetse uhskho uniyohihstiyi a uwenvhsenho, ale wuhskutehse titahstutiyi aya'v'i,
ale uyholhe uhsko athelitokihi kalhte'i, ale athv unhele'i; ahtvnho utsi unele'i.
kvwhstawatitohinho unathvkanv, uniluhtse ale uninese ayelv'i a ale atselihstv uninvne'i.
ketsinvhsitvnho unatalhihsanhe tsihsa etohv'i, ale kvwanonhele nikatv nunatvnelitolv'i ale nahskwo nuhstv' tunateyhonhv'i.
hiano ntuwehsele'i, itena itsvhsvkwo iyvtv witilohi inake tikesv'i, ale lheka itsatsawehsolvhsta; unitsatheyhenho ani'luhke ale taneke'i, vlhehno yatlatnvtatihske nahskwo unalhstayvhtiyi ikohitv.
tsiyuhinho unatsa'e'i, unanhikihse inake wunilohse utelitv.
yvwinho kvwanikohe ananhikihskv'i, ale unitsathe kvwolhke'i, ale elatikwo tunihskwalhthane nanhahititlv wunilohse tekatuwhatihsv nitotayunilohsvhi, tekvwanikhiyenho, ale wikvwatalhihsanele'i.
tsihsanho utsa'ihsv, tukohe unitsathi yvwi, ale tuwetolitse'i, nvtikalhstohtihske awhi uninotena tanatselhakv nehvna tsikehso unikhthiya; ulenvhenho utsathi tsutalenhvtv tuweyhonhe'i.
nhahkwonho ulohsonhitena kehse ika, kwahstawatitohi kvwaluhtsele'i hi'a nuniwehse'i, anhi inake'i, ale nhahkwo ulohsonhiti ika.
thiyhelihihsta, nahski tatanelatihsv kvwathuwitv wani'lohi, ale tekatuwhatisv'i, ale wuniwhahi katu, vtleyhenho kohuhsti yaniyhe unalhstayvhti.
tunhetselenho hi'a nituwehsele'i, nihi titselhsta.  hi'anho nikvwawehsele'i, tsiko tayotsehsi thalitskwi anikisi tsukvwalhti katu wv'tayokiwhahsi, ale totayotselhsthani?
hano ntuwesele'i, hilako katu tetsiyheha?  witsakhtha.nh unatolehohsvnho, hi'a nuhiwehse'i, hihski, tha'linho atsa'ti.
tunetselenho unanhtlvtiyi nikatv itse khanehskohi kehsv' tsunatalhunhvtv.
unanhtlvnenho ohstv tunatanvnhhne'i ahskohitskwi, ale hihskahskohi tsuntalhunvtv.
hihskino katu tukihshv ale thali atsati tunehsv, kalvlati witukhanhahne'iav ale ulihelitse'i, alenvtukvhaluyhe katu, ale kvwhstawtitohi tunhele tsuninhehtiyi; tha'linho atsati nikatv tuyahthohele'i.
nikatvnho unalhstayvnhe'i; ale tunolhvhse'i.
unuthehsenho ulikvhluyhvhi thalatu tikhali'i thalutsa, ale nahskwo atsa'ti.
nahskino na katu tsunikvhi' hihski iyakayvli iyvtv nani'e anihskaya.
kilakwono iyvtv tunvwihsthane kvhwstawatitohi tsiyuh unatsotiyi v ale ikvyi tsunihsohihstiyi, kwetsayiti wuniluhihstiyi, ahsikwo uwahshv' tayelihstihskv unitsathi.
tuyhelihihsthanvnho, otalv wulose utatolihsthanvhse'i.
uhsvnho nulshthanv tsiyu vtali ayelhi aninihse'i, uwahsvno tyi etohi.
tukohenho anikilhiyokv anikawehihv'iai wanikhthvhnho itisi tikanolvtihske'i.  nhvhkinenho iyvtv aniyahwskv hsvnoyi tuluhtsele'i, vtali katu'i a'ise'i, ale yitulohihsele'i.
ahsenho wkvwakohv vtali katu'i a'ihsv'ihi utselvnhvhi unelihse'i, ale unelhunhe'i.
(nikatvyhenho kvwakohe'i v ale unateyhahthanele'i.)  khilakwono iyvtv tulinohehthane'i, ale hi'a nituwehsele'i, ukalhstikwo itsatanhthata; ayvkwo; lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti.
ukhilhawhihsenho' witutsanele tsiyuhi; kanolvvhskvnho uhselikotse'ivv ale ulohsvhsthanvhi unatanhthehthane totsunatanhthv'i, ale unihskwanikohse'i.
vlhayhenho yitunatanthelhe katu; tsuninawhiyheno tihstayiyu kese'i.
tunihsohtsvnho, kenihsilati wuniluhtse'i, ale unithalate'i.
tsiyuhinho unatsa'ihsv khilakwo iyvtv kvwolhtse'i.
ale nanhahkvwhathuwitv unetole'i, ale tsunitlvki tuninhitole' titsehstokihi tunilhvte, witaninhohihe' anathvkvka nanhahetohv'i.

ale lvhtlv wika'luhki v tsusti' tekatuhv' v ale tsuthvna tekatuhv'i ale iyvtv titanelohi kehsv'i, tsunitlvki tekalanvtv taninv'vhske'i, ale kvwathayohsehe unahsvnhstiyi, kataluyathvkwo nahskw unhuwv'i; nani'vno nahski kvwahsvnhilvhi tunatiwhske'i.
tekvwalawitsolheno anikwalihsi v ale khilo iyunhski tinowelihski, tsiluhsilimi nvtayunilohsvhi.
tunikohvnho ikatv kvwhahstawatitohi katu anikihskv tikataha tsunoyeni kvhti, (nahski nitunahsulehvna kathka, i unihsonvtsele'i.
anikwalihsihyeno v ale nani'vkwo anitsuhsihv iyunho' ohstv nitunhsulehvna yiki, vlha yinalihstayvhvhsko'ihi tanikhanhahwateko nuniwehsv ethi unatenhvhi.

ale kanhtohtiyi tvnilohi, iyunho'initunhsulehvna yiki, vlha yvkvnalhstayvhvka i ale utsatha nutale kohuhsti tsunikhanhahwtvhstih nunvnelv i nahski tsulihskwiti tikuhilo'v'i ale tithelito, ale vtsayi tikolhvhthanvhi tithelito, ale tinhtlvtiyi.

nhahkwonho anikwalihs ale tinowhelihski ikvwahthvtvnhe hi'a nikvwawehsele'i; katonho ketsstawatitohi vlha yitanikhanhahwateka ethi unatenhvhi uninhetsv'i, nahski nitunhsulehvnakwo tsanalihstayvhvhska?

tunhetshelvnho hi'a nituwehsele'i v ihsaya yelikwo nuwesv' utolehohsv nihi' itsatlonahsti itsine'ihstihskv'i, hi'a tsinikvnhv tsikowhelaav hi'a nahski yvwi kvkilvkwtiha tunihaneka'lv' tantiha, tsuninawihskini invhiyu nitunvnhahteka ayv nakwatvnhv'i.
ahsenho, ahsekwokwo kvkilvkwohtiha tsitanateyohvhska tanateyohvhskv yvwikwo uninetsvhi.
iyvtvyhenho nitsvne unelhanvhi unhetsvhi, yvwi unhnetsv tikhanhahwtvhsti nitsvneha, nahski tithelito' ale tsulihskwiti tikuhilo'v'i; ale utsatha nutaleha nahskiya ulhoyi tetsilvwhihstaneho'i.
ale hi'a ntuwehsele'i, ohsikwo nitsatvneha tsitsiyo'ihseha unelhanvhi unhetsv'i nahski itsatseli tikhanhahwatvhsti itsihskwanikototiyi.
mohsiyhenho hi'a nuwehse'i i hilvkwotehsti tsatota ale tsatsihv ale, khilo ahski nvtihskehsti utota ale utsi v ahse uyohuhihsti kehsehsti.

nihskini hi'a nitsiweha, iyunho khilo hi'a nikawehsehehsti utota ale utsi, kokwani, (nahski katvkhv, akwalhskolhthanvhi,) nika'v ketsalhstehltohti kehsv ayv kvhstelihskv'i; [nahski ututaletv kehsehsti.]
ale' vtl nhahakwo unelaki kohuhsti witatvnhihsi utot ale utsi yetselihseho'i;
nahski unelhanvhi utseli khanohetv ahsekwo nitsvneho itstihsko nihi itsinetsv'i; ale utsathi iyutaleki nahski iyuhstitani nitsatvneho'i.
nikatvnho yvwi wituyhanvhv, hi'a ntuwehsele'i v skiyathvtahstahsi' nitsi'v'ihv ale itsolhki;
vtlhno kohuhsti yvwihi toytitlv ehi, uyvha, nahski kataha yinuwaneho'i; nahskini nvtayunukotsvhi v nahski kataha nuwaneho yvwi.
khilo tekalihlkehsti uthvkotiyi, nahski wathvkvka.
kalhtsotenho wuyvlhv tutanv'elv yvwi, kvhwstawatitohi kvwahthvtvnhe talhilohstv ukvwalhi.
hiano nituwehsele'i, nahskwohsko nihi nahski ika'i nitsolhkvna iki?  lhahsko yitskowhahthiha, nahski kohuhsti toyititlv ehi nahski yuyvhiha yvwi kataha ikvwanhti nikehsvna kehsv'i;
nahski unawhiyi winayvhihvna kesv iyuhstiai uhskwolhiyikwohskini, ale wikalohihstihskvkwo, nahskino kanvkalihskv nika'v alhstayvhti?
hianho nuwehse'i, nahski na yvwihi unukotsvhi nahski kataha nuwaneho yvwi.
hawiniyhenho nvtayutalenhvhi i yvwi unawhiyi, titalehvhska uyo atanhthehti kehsv'ihv hatayhonehti kesv'i, utelitv tinhsihti kesv'i, atahihsti kehsv'i,

kanohskitv kesv'i, tsukvwalhti' akhvvhihsti kehsv'i, uyo iyatvneti kehsv'i, kalonuhetv kehsv'i, alhsotlv'ihstohti kehsv'i, atvyhuketi kehsv'i, atahsotlvihstohtiyi, atlvkwtohtiyi, alhskanhahwihsti kehsv'i.
hi'a nahski nikatv uyo'i' hawin titalehvhsko'i, ale kataha nuwaneho yvwi.
nanhhanho tulenhv, thaya ale satoni ahstv wuluhtse'i, ale atanelv wuyvlhv', vlha yutulihske khilo utolehohihstiyi; ahseno' vlha kvwatihskalhti yikehse'i.
khilohyeno iyuhsti akeyhv nahski uwetsi athvnutsa kataha atanhto' uya'i v uthvkanv atsinohehskvi, uluhtse ale tulahskv utanvne'i:
(nahski na akeyhv ako'i kese'i, ahsalokwinihsi kehse'i;) ale nahski uhstiyethane nahski uwetsi atvnutsa ahskina unukowhisehtiyi.
ahsenho tsihsa hia nuwehsele'i, ikvyi tiniyolhi witanolhvhi v vtlayeno ohsiyu yiki, tiniyolhi tsunatseli katu tiki'ehtiyi, ale kilhi witatinehtiyi.
nahskino unhetse hi'a nuwehsele'ivv utohiyuhi, tsakvwiyuhiav ahsenho kilhi kahskilv hawinititlv tiniyolhi uninvkohihselvhi katu analhstayvhtihsko'i.
hianho nuwehsele'i, nahski' hi'a tsiniwi winikalhstohta, tsihena; ahskina tsetsiyi aya'v unukoki.
nahskino tsuwenvhsv wi'uluhtsv, utolehohse ahskina unukotsv'i, uwetsinho atsehstokihi kanvhkv'i.
ale thaline thaya ale hsatoni ahstv unhikihsv kelili' vtalv wuluhtse'i, ayelhi ulohse ahskohi-tikatukiyi skatuki kehsv'i.
ikvwahthinohelenho khilo tsuli'ena, ale kanila kawo'nihski; ale ikvwhstiyethane nahski uhsihthatihstiyi.
iyvhtvn wuthinhvhsthanv utayelilv unitsathi anetohv'i, tekayehsatv tikaleni tuhsona'te'i, ale tulitsihskwe'i, ale kanhko uhsvnhile'i;
kalvlatin witukhanhahnv uliyethane'ivi ale hi'a nuwehsele'i, ekweta, nahski katkvh halhstu'i.
kilakwono iyvtv tikaleni tulhstu'ihse'i, ale kanhko ulhvhstanelvhi tulikhaneyhvhe, ale ohstv uwonihse'i.
tunvhstatelenho khilo uninonhehtiyi; ahsenho tekanvhstatihsi hutlikwo ika'i taniyelihihstihske'i;
al ulohsvhsthanvhi unihskwanikohse'i, ha na'niwehske'i, nikatv ohsiyu teulvwhihstasi; unathvkotiyi nitekvne tsunili'ena, tsunvkhewinho uniwonihihstiyi.
nahiyunho unitsathi kehsv yvwi tskwiya kehsv iyuhsti, ale nunihvna kehsv unalhstayvhti v tsihsa wituyhanvhv kvhwstawtitohi, hi'a ntuwehsele'i;
katsiyatolika unitsathi kehsv'i v nvtikalhstohti nhahkwo tso'i ika itsulaha oketolv'i ale nunihvna kesv unalhstayvhti;
iyunho yikatsiyanikihstiha totsunenvhsv yaneka nunalhstayvnhvna v wanaihsvkwo yitaniwanakaloki v ikatvyhenho' invhiyu totsunenv.
kvwhstawatitohinho hi'a nikvwawehsele'i v hatlv yitaki khilo nahski ika'i katu anhi inake'i v hi'a nahski yeli kvwanithvhtanhthi.
tutvtvnhenho hi'a nuwhse'i; hilako katu tetsiyheha? i hi'anho nuniwehse'i, kalhkwoki.

tunhetselenho unitsathi katoh unahntlvtiyi; kalhkwokinho katu tukihsv, ale ulihelitsv, tukhaluyhe'i, ale kvhwstawtitohi tunhele' nahski ikvyititlv tsuninhehtiyi; ikvyititlvno tuninhele unitsathi yvwi.
ale ilvhski tsunhsti atsa'ti taninhehe'i, ulihelitshvnho unhetse nahski nahskwo ikvyititlv tsuninvthiyi.
unalhstayvnhenho, ale tunolhvhse'i; unuthehsenho ulikvhluyhv'hi uthiyvhi kalhkwoki iyakhali'i thalutsa.
unalihstayvnhvhinho nvhki iykayvli iyvtv nani'e'i; tuyelihihsthane'no.
ikvwenvtvnho tsiyuhi utsane anehe kvhwstawatitohi, ale taliminuta ahstv wuluhtse'i.
anikwalihsinho uniluhtse ale unalenvhe kvwahtvtvhelvne'i, kvwathayohsele tsunanukowhihsehtiyi uyelhtv kalvlati nvtaylohsvhi, kvwakoliyehske'i.

utanhtokihino hawini uliyethane'ihv ale hi'a nuwehse'ivv katonho khohi hi'a tsaneha uyelhtv uniyhoha?  utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha v vlha khvnikesv ikekvnhehti yikehsehsti uyelhtv hi'a khohi tsaneha.
tutanv'elvnho, ale hthaline tsiyuh utsanv, ahskhona wulose'i.
[kvhwstawatitohihno v unvkhewhsvhi kese katu tsunatenhtiyi, vlha ale yulohsvhste hsakwo katu unilhv tsiyuhi.
tunhetselenho hi'a nuwese'isi itsiyahwskehsti i anikwalihsi untseli akohtohti itseyahthotsehehsti, ale eloti utseli akothohti.
unvhsvnho kehsv unalhinohelhe'i hi'a nuniwehse'i, nvtikalhstohtiha katu nititiyhehvna kehsv'i.
tsihsano utolehohsv hi'a ntuwehsele'i, katonho itsalhinoheha katu nititsiyhehvna kehsv iyuhsti?  ahsikwohsko nitsatolehohskvna iki'i ale nitsolhkvna iki?  ahsikwohsko ahstaya nitetsvnhv titsinawhi?
tetsikhanhvhsko, nitsikowhahthihskvnanho iki?  tetsilihlkahsko v nitsathvkihskvna'nho iki?  ale nitsanhtatihskvnahsko iki?
hihski katu takikvhaluyv hihski iyakyvli tetsinelv v hilako iyakhali thalutsa ulkvhaluyhvhi itsuthehse'i? v thalatu ikvwohsele'i.
kalhkwokinho [katu] nvhki iyakyvli tetsinelv, hilak iyakhali thalutsa ulikvhaluyvhi' itsuthehse'i?  kalhkwoki unatvnhe'i.
hiano ntuwehsele'i, kato kalhstohtiha nitsolhkvna tsiki?
kwetsayitinho wuluhtse'i; tikhewino ahskaya kvwahthinhohele'i, ale unithayohsele nahski uhsvnhstiyi.
tikhewino uwoyhanehsv i katuhv unukowhise'i; tikhtholino tulitsihskwv, ale tuhsihthatv, kohuhstihsko hikowahtthiha?  uwohsele'i.
tukhanhahnvnho, hia nuwese'i, yvwi katsikowahthiha anekiha tetluhkv nahskiya'i.
nhahkwonho thaline tikhtholi tuhsihthate'i, ale tsukhanhtiyi nuwanhele'i; ale utiwhse'i, ale nani'v ohsiyu takowahthihske'i.
ale unhetsele tsuwenvhsv wulohihstiyi, hia nuwehse'i i lhehsti tkatuhv witsayvlhvki, ale lhehsti khilo katuhv ehi hinonhelvki.
tsihsanho unukotse ale nahski kvhwstawatitohi, sihsaliyi kwiliki tekatuhv wunilohse'i; wana'ihsvnho tuthvtvnhe kvhwstawtitohi i hi'a ntuwesele'i, kako kvkwohseho yvwi?
hi'anho nuniwehse'i, tsani titawohski; ikatvhskini ilaya [anatiha i v ikatvnho, khilo' iyuhsti anatolehohski.
han ntuwehsele'i, nihinano kako hskiyohseha? v kwitanho unhetsv hia nuwehsele'ihv kalonetv nihi.
tunetselenho nahski khilo uninonhehtiyi nikehsvna.

ulenvhenho tuweyhone'i, nahski yvwi uwetsi' utsathi' tsutalenhvtv uki lhiyo'ihstiy; ale kvwayo'ihsehti kehsv tinilawiki, ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale tinowhelihski v ale atsi'ihstiyi kehsv'i, tso'inenho ika tsulehihsohti kehsv'i.
nahskino hi'a kvnikehsv nuwehse'i. i kwitanho uyanvhv ulenvhe ukvhskolvne'i.

ahsenho ukthahvhsv, ale kvwhstawatitohi tukhanhahnv, kwita ukvhskolvne'i, hi'a nuwehse'i, akwahsohthv halehvka hsetani; vtlayhehno unelhanvhi utseli 'kehsv ohsiyu yitsayelvha v yvwihskini unatseli kehsv'i.
wituyhanvhvnho yvwi, ale nahskwo kvwhstawtitohi v hi'a nituwehsele'i, khilo utulihskehsti akhstawatvhstiyi, uwahsv atatahyihehsti, ale uwahsv utseli tsutanhawatv ayihskehsti, ale akhstawatekesti.
khiloyheno utulihskehsti kvnhv uhstelhtiyi, nahski uyohuhsehehsti; khilohskini kvnhv uyohuhsehehsti ayv ale ohstv khanohetv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, nahski atsihstelhti kehsehsti.
katoyhenho yunhehkwotsi yvwi, iyunho nikvnhathv elohi utseli yinulhsthanv v uwahsvnho utanhto yuyohuhselv?
ale kato yahvka yvwi yikanetliyvhsta utanhto?

khiloyheno akwatehohskehsti ayv, ale ayv tsinekv'i, utahsuyv anhi tinatayhonehi ale anihskana anehv'i, nahski nahskwo yvwi uwetsi utehohihsti kehsehsti, kaluhtsvha unhuwohstehsti kalvkwtiyu kehsv utota utselika v anehehsti ketsilvkwoti tinikhanhahwatitohi.

hi'an nituwehsele'i, utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha v nahski khilo' anhi tsitanitoka, vlha yvtvnatolehohsi ayohuhsti kehsv'i, khvnhi unikohvhi kehsehsti unelhanvhi ukvwiyuh kehsv' ulhiniktiyu kesv kaluhtsvha.
hsutalinho wnuhsvlhv tsihsa tuthinhvhse kwitahv ale tsimi v ale tsani', invnho ikathi otalv tunhahlthane iyvtv unvhsv kehsv'i; ale utanetliyvhse anikhthahv'i.
tsunhuwonho' tuthalukihske'i, utsathi tsunekiyu kese'i vnhtsi tsinunekiyv nahskiya'i; nahski' vlha khilo tikhkilohski anhi elohi ehi nahski itsunekv yinitokakvka.
khvnikehsvnho nikvwantvnhele ilay ale mohsi; tsihsanho kvwalhinohehtihske'i.
kwitanho unhetsv hia nuwehsele tsihsa, thateyhohvhski v ohsiyu' ani tsitetoha; ale tso'i witotsilihtsothvka v sakwo nihi tsatselika, sakwonho mohsi' utselika, sakwonho ilaya utselika.
vtlayhenho yakhthahe iyuwehstiyi; utsa thiyhenho anihska'ihe'i.
ulokilvnho unhulhvthane'i v khanekvnho' ulokilv tsunanukotse'i, hi'a nikawehske'i v hi'a nahski tsikeyu'i akwetsi; nahski etsathvtahstasi.
khilakwono' iyvtv tunakhanhahnitolv, vtl nhahakwo khilo yunikohe'i, tsihsa uwahsv, ale unvhsv.
tsunikhso'ahsitihsvnho otalv'i, tunhetsel nahski khilo uninonhehtiyi nikehsvna nuhstv unikohv'i, khvnhi yvwi uwetsi uyohuhsv tsulehihsanhi kehsehsti tuwohsele'i.
nahskinho nuwehsv unakhsahysthane'i v tanatathvtvhvhske kathkv ayohuhsv tilehihsohti kehsv'i.
kvwahtvtvnhenho hi'a nuniwehse'i, katonho tinowhelihski ilaya ikvyi takaluhtsi tsanatihsko'i?

unhetsvnhoh hi'a nituwehsele'i v ilaya utohiyuhi ikvyi uluhihsti, ale nikatv uwolhvhihsohti; ale nahskwo hi'a nikvnhv kowhela yvwi uwetsi atsinohehskv'i, nahski' utsathi tsutalenhvtv ukilhiyo'ihsti kesehsti v ale ahsekwo tayetsiyelvni.
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehsehahv ilaya utohiyuhi uluhtsv, ale nuhstv unatulihskv nikvwanelv, nahskiya nikvnhv kowhelv nahski atsinohehskv'i.
kvwhstawa'titohino' anetohv uluhtsv, unitsathi tukohe kvwantalhuwhihste'i v ale tinowhelihski kvwanathvtvhelhvihske'i.
kilakwonho iyvtv nikatv yvwi, kvwakohv, utsathi unihskwanikohse'i; kvwatlhaohelvnho kvwayolile'i.
tuthvtvnhenho tinowhelihski, kato tetsathvtvhelhv'vhska tuwohsele'i?
ahsiyvwinho nahski unitsathi kehsv khela unhetsv hia nuwehse'i, thateyohvhski v kvyathinhohihsi akwetsi, uwakhewi atanhtho' uwe'i;
ilvhtlvnho uhyilohihsi ukilhvhsko'i; ale tahawo'iho'i, ale tekalvtakihsko tekanhtohkv'i, ale ulvtehiho'i; ketsstawatitohinho katsithayohselv uninukowhihstiyi; ahsenho uninulvnhvkwo.
unhetselvnho, hi'a nuwehse'iai yo!  nitsohiyuhsvna khohi tsitseha!  hilako ikohitv itsvyelatitohehsti?  hilako ikohitv unelaki itsvyelihsehehsti? v anhi hiyathinhoka.
unathinohelenhovv ukohvnho khilakwo iyvtv atanhto ukilhvnhe'i; elatinho unvtse'i, ale tahawo'ihv alitihsvnhihe'i.
utvtvnhenho utota, hilako nikohiki nahski hi'a ikvwalhstanhelvhi?  uwohsele'i ahi ayolhikwo kehsv'i, utvnhe'i;
yanokiyunho atsilvyi ale asuyi uta'eko'i, nahski uhihstiyi; iyuhskininonv kohuhsti ketsatvnhti kehsehsti, skistoliki, ale skihstelv.
tsihsanho hia nuwehsele'i, iyunho ketsohyuti kehsehstiav nikatiyu kohuhsti' ikayekatvnhehti kohiyuhvhski.
khilakwonho' iyvtv ayolhi utota uwelhunhe'i, ale tikvkhsawo'ihi hi'a nuwehse'i v tsakvwiyuhi, ko'iyuhvhska; skihstelvhsi' nakwohiyusvna kesv'i.

tsihsanho ukohv nahski unitsathi ananelukihskv anatalhihsihskv'i, uhskatse' kataha atanhto v hia nuwehsele'i, tsvkhewa ale titsali'ena atanhto, kvnetsheha, ehinuko'i, ale lhehsti nhahkwo ilvhiyu tsihiyvlhi.
[atanhtonho] uwelhunhvai ale utsathi ukilhvnhv, unukotse'i; ale uyohuhsvhikwo nahskiya kese'i; nahski iyuhsti unitsathe, ayohuhi i anatihske'i.
ahsenho tsihsa uwoyhanehsv, tulehthane'i, ale tulenhe'i.
kalhtsotenho wiuyvlhv, kvhwstawtitohi unvsv kesv kvwahtvtvnhe'i, katonho ayv vlha kayotsinukowhihsti yikehse'i?  unatvnhe'i.
hin ntwehsele'i, hi'a nahski iyuhsti vlha yvkayekanukowha v kvnhi atatolihsthanvhi ale amalhi kvnhvhi tsikehso'i.
unanhikihsvnho nanhahni, kelili ayelhi unilohse'i; vlhanho yutulihske khilo utolehohihstiyi.
tuweyhonhyeno kvhwstawtitohi v ale hi'a nituwehsele'i, yvwi uwetsi tatsiyohi teketsiyohihs yvwi. ale takvwhali; ale onhi nhahkwo atsilvhi kehsehstiai totvalehihsanhi tso'ine ika.
ahsenho vlha yunolhtse nahski nuwehshv ale anihska'ihe unathvtvhtiyi.
kekwaninho uluhtsilhe'iav kalhtsokanho aya'v tuthvtvnhehi kato nahski tsitsinhohehskv' itsvhsv kehsv a tita'ihsv'i.
ahsenho elhaweyikwo unvhse'iai tina'ihsvnho aninhohehske unvhsv kehsv nahski utli' atsilvkwotiyu kesv'i.
uwenhvnho, thaltu iyanitv wituyhanvhe'i, ale hi'a nituwesele'i v iyunho khilo ikvyi iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti, nahski' onhiyi akaletohti kesehsti nani'v'i v ale nani'v kvwanvhsitohi kehsehsti.
ayolhino wuyhanvhv, aninv ayelhi uwekhanhe'i; unhulholnho hi'a nituwehsele'i,

khilo ahsiyvwi hi'a iyunhsti tiniyolhi tatanilvkehst ay ayv takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, ayv takwatanilvkehstivi khilonho ayv takwatanilvkehsti, vlha ayv yitakwatanilvkehsti, nvtvkinvhsitvhskini tatanilvkehsti.
tsaninho unetsele'i, hi'a nuwese'i, thateyhohvhskiav otsikohvki ahsiyvwi anihskina tekanukowhihskvki tetsato'v khtihskvki; vlhanho yikihstawatitoha; otsinvhstatelvkinho nikihstawatekvna kesv iyuhsti.
ahsenho tsihsa hia nuwehse'i, lhehsti etsinvhstatelvki; vtlayheno yeha khilo takwato'v khtihski uhskwanikhti tsulvwhihstanehiav nahski ikvwenvtv uhsonv' kvkhine'ihstohti.
khiloyhenho nahski nikatlutihskvna tsikehso, nahski ikalikonhehi kehso'i.

khiloynho ama ulihskwiti akhali'i itsatithahsti itsinenhehi ayv takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, kalonetv etsatseli kehsv iyuhsti, utohiyuhya itsvyohseha, vlha uyohuhsehti yikehsehsti akakuyv'ehti kehsv'i.
ale khilo ahsiyvwi hi'a tsunsti kehsv nahski tsikvkwohiyuhvhska tokotehstihskehsti, utli' ohsiyu iyulhstanhehti ahstohski nvya yatsiyalhanv v ale amekwohi yiwaka'ta'inv.

iyu ale tsoyeni tetsotehstihskehsti, hihskwalhskehstihv utli ohsiyu itsalhstanehti tsakolani kvnhitv tikehsv' yiwitsayvlhv, anho itsula tikehoyati tsvhskino yiwitsayvlhv, nanhahatsilvhyi kakhtlattihsti nikehsvna;
nanhahunatseli tsskoyv nikaliwhokvna tikehsv'i, ale atsilv nikhtlohskvna tikehsv'i.

iyu ale tsalahsihteni totsotehstihskehsti, hihskwalhskehsti; utliyhenho ohsiyu itsalhstanhehti hiyo'ulhi kvnhitv tikehsv yiwitsayvlhv'i anho itsula tiketsalahski tsvhskino yiwetsata'inv, nanhahatsilvhyi kakh tlattihsti nikesvna;
nanhahunatseli tsskoyv nikaliwhokvna tikehsv'i, ale atsilv nikhtlohskvna.

iyu ale hikhtholi totsotehstihskehsti, hatakhtheto'ihskehsti; utliyhenho ohsiyu itsalhstanhehti hsakwokwo hyikhanv unelhanvhi utselikohi' yiwitsayvlhv anho itsula yithihkhanhv tsvhskinho atsilvhyi yiwetsata'inv;
nanhahunatseli tsskoyv nikaliwhokvna tikesv'i, ale atsilv nikhtlohskvna tikesv'i.
nani'vyno atsilv kvhti ~ama ketsinvtlayeti kehsehsti, ale nika'v atsilv-kelhsti i ama kanvliyeti kehsehsti.
ama ohsiyu i ahsenho ~ama yutsihskolhv kato yitsvka nutsihskolhvna yinitsvka?  ~ama' itsihltsvhi kehsehsti, ale thohiyi nitsvnhehsti itsehv'i.
nanhahno tulenhv, tsutiy kata ahvi uluhtse'i, tsotani ahskonititlv tsulohihsthane'i i ale unitsathi yvwi thaline ikvwatalhihsanele'i; ale iyutvnhti kehsv nutvnele'i v tha'line tuweyhonhe'i.
anikwalihsinho kvwaluhtshelv kvwahthvtvnhe'iav hi'a nuniwehse'i v tuyukhtihsko ahskaya uta'invtiyi utali'i?  kvwakoliyehske'i.
unhetsvnho hi'a nisuwehsele'i v kato uhste itsinetsel mohsi?
han nnwsi, mohsi ulhskolhthane kowhelotiyi tkalnvhv'i, l atainvhtiyi.
tsihsanho unhetsv, hi'a nituwehsele'i i tihstayiyu kehsv iyuhsti titsinawhi hi'a nahski tikhanhahwatvhsti itsowhelanele'i;
titalenihskvhskini uwelhvnhvnvhi, unelhanvhi ahskaya ale akeyhv tuwolhvnhe'i.
nahsk iyst askaya tekhtekehsti utota ale utsiyv ale utali'i atlatwhstihskehsti;
nahskino anithalih sakwokwo kehsehsti unikwetalhv'ihv nahskino' vlha nhahkwo anithali yiki v sakwokwohskini unikwetalhv'i.
nahski iyuhsti' unelanvhi tsuwutahthanvhi tlehsti yvwi tsukalenhthanvki.
kalhtsotenho aniya'v kvwhstawatitohi thaline ikvwahthvtvn nski ukvwali.
hi'anho nituwehsele'i a khilo utali'i ata'ekehsti, ale nvwatale atayhekehsti, nahski atayhonehehsti ahskanvtsehehsti' nahski.
iyu' ale akeyhv uyhehi ata'ekehsti, ale nvwatale tanahtsekehsti, nahski atayhonehehsti.
tsunhstinho tiniyolhi tekvwathinohele'i i nahski tsuhsvnhstiyi; kvhwstawtitohinho tunikvhskolvne nahski tsunahthinolhvhi.

tsihsahskini ukohv utsathi svhska uyelvnhe'i, ale hi'a ntuwehsele'i v unelaki tetselihsehehsti tsunhsti tiniyolhi kvkiluhtsehtiyiai ale lhehsti yititsinvhstatehehsti; nahskiyhenho nunahsti unelhanvhi utselikohi.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha, iyunho khilo unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kesv nitatanilvkvna ikehsehsti nahskiya ayolhi tsitatanilvko'i, vlha' nanhahayiwvkvyvha.
tunehsvnho ale tuhsithatv, ohstv tunhetsele'i.

unhikihsvnho kanvnhv wuluhtsv, khilo' iyuhsti utlho'elvki, ale tulhinikwanvnelvki, uthvtvnhe hi'a nuwehsele'i, hohstv thateyohvhskihv kato takatvneli ulhskwatihsti nikehsvna kvnhitv akwatseli iyulhstohtiy?
tsihsanho hia nuwehsele'i, katonho hohstv ihskwohseh ayv?  vlha khilo ohstv yikiav sakwo uwahsvhiyu, nahski unelhanvhi.

tehikhthaha tikhanhahwtvhsti, nahski, lhehsti tsatayonelvki v lhehsti tsatalhvkiav tlehsti tsanohskisvki, lhehsti kayhkoki tsanohelhvkihi lhehsti tsatalonuhelhvki v tsatota ale tsatsi tehi'lvkwtehsti.
unhetsv'n hia nuwehsele'i, thateyohvhski, hi'a nahski nikatv takhskwanikothanv tsitshutsa kesv nvtakvwatalenvtv.

tsihsanho tukhanhahnv, ukeyuhiyu nulhsthane'i, ale hia nuwehsele'i v sutaleki tsalulavi hena whinatuka nika'v kohuhsti tsanha'v'ihv ale uyo iyunatvnhahteki kinelvha, tsohsvnho witsahehsti tsukvwalhti; ale thehsvha, tsutanhahwatv hiyvhvhahi ale skhstawatehsvha.
uyonho uyelvnhe nahski natsiwehselv i ale ehihsti kvwatanhthi utanvhse'ivi utsathihyenho unhahai.
tsihsanho uthuwhitv tukhanhahnitolv, hi'a ntuwehsele kvwhstawatitohi, nahstaya tsukvwalhti unihi unelahvhi utselikohi wuniyvhstiyi.

kvhwstawatitohino kvwahskwanikohsele nahski nuwehsv'i.  ahsenho tsihsa thaline i'unhetsv i hi'a ntuwehsele'i, titsiyolhi. v nahstaya nahski kenhv'ihsti kesv analhskahstohtihski, unelanvh utselikohi wuniyvhstiyi.
utli ahitiyu khemili yvk kahsanhenatvtiyi ukhthvlehihstiyi, anho uwenhahi yvwi unelhanvhi utselikohi wuyvhstiyi.
ulohsvhsthanvhinho unihskwanikohske'i v hi'a nitanatawehsehe'i v kakokhe yeli kayetsihstelhti?
tsihsanho nahski tukhanhahnv, hia nuwehse'i, yvwi kehsv nahski ikvtvnhti nikehsvna, unelhanvhihskini kesv vtla; unelhanvhyenho kehsv nika'v kohuhsti ikvtvnhti.
nhahkwonho kwita ulenvhe hi'a nuwehsele'i, khvnhiyukwo ayv nikatiyu okhtetsonv, ale nihi itsvhstawatenv.

tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehse'i v utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha, vlha khilo yeha nahski uwtetsvhi ikehsehsti atanelv'i, ale analhinvtli, ale tsuto, ale utota, ale' utsiai ale' utali'i, ale tsuwetsi, ale tulokehsv'i, ayv kehsv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, ale ohstv khanohetv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti,

nahski khohi kehsv atsinehti nikehsvna kehsv ahskohitskwi iyuwakhti' ulosvhsti tatanelv'ihi ale analhinvtli, ale tsuto, ale tsutsi, ale tsuwetsi, ale tekalokehshv'i, akilhiyo'ihsti kehsv thali utvti v so'iyinho tikehsv' ulhskwatihsti nikehsvna kvnhitv.
ahsenho unitsatha nahski ikvyi tsiki i onhi kehsehsti; onhinho tsiki, ikvyi kehsehsti.

kanvnhvnho ana'ise tsiluhsilimi tsanikhthe'i a tsihsanho ikvyi tuwenv'ele'i v unihskwanikohsenhoai nahskn analhstawatihsv anihska'ihe'i. a thalinenho tuyanvhv thalatu iyanitv, ulenvhe tunonhele nahski iyulhstanhelitahsti kehsv'i.

[hi'a nikawehske'i;] khvnhiyukwo tsiluhsilimi witikhthi v ale yvwi uwetsi totayetsiyohsi nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv anelhohi ale tinowelihski totaketsiyohihseliav ale totakvwukhtaneli uyohuhihstiyi i ale tsunatalenhvtv yvwi witotvniyohihseli;
ale takvwahsotlv'ihsthani, al takvwalivnhili, ale totakvwalitsihskwi, ale takvwhali; tso'ineno ika tha'line totvalenhi.
tsiminho ale tsani, tsekwiti tsuwetsi kvwaluhtshele'iav hia nuniwehse'i, thateyhohvhski, skinatuliha ihskinatvnhehtiyi nuhstv' ihstvthayohsehti kesv'i.
han nituwehsele'i, katonho ihstatuli ihstvyatvnhehtiyi?
hanho nikvwawehsele'i, skinalihskolhtahsi, nahski' tsokinitiyi, ahsiyvwi hikhthihsititlv, so'inho hikhskanititlv i tsatseli kalvkwtiyu kehsv'i.

ahsenho tsihsa hi'a nituwehsele'i, vlha yihstikhthaha nuhstv ihstithayohihv'i.  tsisa yelikwo kehstatithahsti ulihskwiti nahski akwatithahsti tsiki? v ale tikayehstawohsti nahski titawohsti kehsv nahski vkwawohstohti tsiki?

hi'anho nikvwawehsele'i, yelikwo.  tsihsanho hi'a nituwehsele'i, utohiyuh tahstatithahi ulihskwiti nahski ay akwatithahsti tsiki, ale titawohsti kesv ayv vkwawohstohti tsiki v nahski totayehstawohsthani;
uwehtiyihskini akwolhv tsikathihsi ititlvav ale tsikahskani ititlv, vlha ayv akwatanhehti yiki; unvhsvhskini nahski kekatvnhv'ihstanelvhi tsiki
ahskohinho iyanitv unathvkanv, unalenvhe utsathi ehska tuniyelvnanele tsimi ale tsani.

ahsenho tsihsa wituyhanvhv hi'a nituwehsele'ihv itsikhthaha nahski unikvwiyuhi ketsiyelvi kesv tsunatalenhvtv yvwi tanewatihsv'iyv tikvwananelhtohtiyi nanvnheho'i; tsunilvkwtinho kesv kvwanatalinehiteho'i.
nihihskini itsehv vlhehsti nahski yinitsvnhehsti; khilohskini atsilvkwoti iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti v nahsk etsinvhsitahsti kehsehsti.
ale khilo nihi nitsatvnhv nukvwiyuhsv iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehstihv nahski nikatv kvwanvsitohi kehsehsti.
nahskwoyhenho yvwi uwetsi vlha yuluhtsv kohuhsti akatvnhehtiyi, kohuhstihskini utatvnhehtiyi, ale kvnhv tsuyohihstiyi' tsukuhytohtiyi unitsathi.
tselikonho uniluhtse'i, ale nahski tseliko i'unukotsv ale nahski kvhwstawtitohi, ale unitsathi yvwi, tikhewi kwatimiya, nahski timiya uwetsi v uwolhe nvnohuhlti atulatihske'i.
uthvkanvnho nahski tsisa nahselthi' ehi kehsv'i, ulenvhe uwelhunhe, hia nuwhse'i, tewi uwetsihi tsihsa, hskitoliki.
unitsathenho kvwakvhskolvne kvwhanetsele elhaweyi u'wvtiyi v ahsenho utlikwo ika'i uwelhunhe'i, tewi uwetsi hskitoliki, atihske'i.
tsihsanho ulewhihsthanv unhetse watsiyantiyi.  uniyanvheno tikhewi v hi'a nuniwehsele'i, ukalhstikwo hatanhtata v thalehvka; titshayaniha.
nahskino uta'inv unhuwo tulenhe'i, ale tsihsa wuluhtsele'i.
tsihsanho unhetsv hia nuwehselei, kato tsatuli kvyatvnhehtiyi?  tikhewinho hi'a nuwehsele'i, tsakvwiyuhi, v'akikowhahthvhtiyi i akwatuliha.]
tsihsano hi'a nuwehsele'i v henakwon; tsohiyuhsv tsahstelv.  kilakwonho iyvtv kvwakowhahthvhti nulhsthane'i, ale uhstawatvhse tsihsa a'ihsv'i.
tsiluhsilimino na'v wuniluhtsv nahskh svkhthohi ale kwetiniy iyvtv i oliwayohi uhsahilhv'i v anithali kvhwstawatitohi tunvhse'i,

ale hi'a ntuwehsele'i, ihstena na tehstitokv tsuyukhti tsvtikatuha wihstitsahi; wihstiyvlhvkwonho' nanhahni, tayehstiwahthvhi tikalianvhitv akina kelihsatehsti, nahski vlha khilo yvwi ukhilvthanvhi yiki v ehstelihsatehsvha ale tsehstathinhehsvha.
iyunho khilo katonho nahski nihstatvneha ihstohselvha v v ukvwiyuhi utuliha, ihstatvnhvha; kilakwonho' iyvtv totayuyohsi' anhi ehstathinhohihstiyi.
unenvhsenho, ale wuniwhahthvhe akina kelihsateh kalohihstiyulhti toytitlv, nanhahtekanvnhv tatlohskv'i; unelihsatehsenho.
khilonho iyunahsti nanhahtinitoki hi'a nituniwehsele'i v katonho' i'ehstelihsate akiwi?
ale nahskiyakwo tsihsa nuwehsv unhetsv nituniwehsele'i:  tuniyohsenho.
akinanho tsihsa unathinohele'i, ale tsunanhuwo tunilhvnele'i; tsihsanho ukhilvthane'i.
unitsathenho tsunanhuwo nvnoh tunuyehstvne'i; ikatvnho telhkv' tunvnikalvhe'i, ale nvnohi tunilkytni.
hikvyihi anekiav ale onhi aneki v unelhuhke'i, hi'a naniwehske'i, hohsana v kalvkhwtiyu kehsehsti yihowa te'utohstv tsikaluhihstihta.
kalvkwtiyu kehsehsti tewi ikitota utseli ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i, nahski yihowa tutohstv tsikaluhihstiha; hosana wahsthv kalvlatiyu.

tsihsanho tsiluhsilimi wuyvlhe'i, ale uthanv-tikalawi'ihstiy wuyvlhe'i; nhahakwonho kvwathuwhitv tukhanhahnitolv nikatv tsutalenhvtv tukhanhahnv, ale nhahkwo usvhiyvyi kehse'i, unukotse kwetiniyi wulohse' anehe thalatu iyanitv.
uktsvtvnho kwetiniyi tsunilohsv akonu uyohsihske'i;

wukohenho ke iyvtv titluhke hsvkhlaiyuhsti, ulhstuhse'i, wuluhtse'i, yahsekaki yitsiwahtv kohuhsti yutha uwelihse'i; nanhahnho wuluhtsv vlha kohuhsti yuwhahthvhe ulhstuhsv'kwo uwhahsv; vtlayheno ahsi' yuhskwalvhe skthiyunasti unvnhstiy.
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsele'i, lhehsti khilo ilvhiyu tsi'aki nihi tsatahthanvhi kohi iyutalenvtv.  kvwahstawatitohinho unathvkane'i.

tsiluhsiliminho uniluhtse'i i tsihsanho uthanv-tikathawi'ihstiyi wuyvlhv, ulenvhe tunukowhihse aninateki ale uniwhahe'vhski nanhahuthanv-tikalawihstiyi, ale tulhukwatinvhse tunihskilv atelv tinitliyvhski, ale unanvtiyi kule -tinihskonhihi tininateki;
ale' vlha unelaki yuwelihsele khilo kohuhsti uhsti' athelito uhytohtiyi uthvnv-tikalawi'ihstiy.

tuteyhonhenho, hi'a nituwehsele'i, tlahsko hi'a yinikvnhv yikowhela v akwatseli atanelv nikatiyu tsunatalenhvtv yvwi unatatolihstohtiyi tuto'ehsti?  nihihskini aninohskihski uniyvhstiyi uhstakalv nitsvnelv.
tinowelihskino ale nunikvwiyusv atsilv-anelhohi unathvkane'i, ale uniyhole iyunvnhtiyi unihihstiyi v kvwanayehskeyhenho, nvtikalhstohtihske nikatv yvwi unihskwanikohskv nuhstv tateyhohvhskv'i.
uhsvnho nulhsthanv unukotse katuhv'i.
sunalenho ana'ihsv'i, unikohehsekhthaiyuhsti tluhkv uwhayvhsvhi kehse tunhahstetlv nvtakvwatalenvtv.
kwitanho unhta'tv hi'a nuwehsele'iav thateyhohvhski, kvniyukwo, ekhtha-iyuhsti tluhkv tsihskatsvki uwhayvhsonhv.
tsihsanho unhetsv, hi'a nituwehsele'i, unelhanvhi etso'iyuhsehsti.

utohiyuhiyayhenho hi'a nitsvwehseha, khilo hi'a nikawehsehehsti hi'a tsotalv i wetsahvna, ale amekwohi wetsatuka; ale nutlahtsithv'ehvna ikehsehsti unawiyi, kohiyuhskehstikwohskini nahski nikawehskv ahse iyulhstohti kesv'i; nahski uhehsti nika'v nuwehsv'i.
nahski iyuhsti hi'a nitsvwehseha, nika'v kohuhsti itsithayoha itsatatolihsta, itsohyuhvhskehsti etsinei kehsv'i i ale ase itsihehsti.

iyunho itsalehvhskehsti itsatatolihstihskehsti, ketsatanhehehsti etsihskanvtselvhi, iyunho kohuhsti etselihsehehsti khilo'i; nahski nahskwo itsitota kalvthati tseha kaketsihntiyi hiha itsihskanvtsvhi.
iyuhskini' nitsatanhehvna ikehsehsti etsihskanvtselv'i, vlha nahskwo itsitota kalvlati ehi yvketsitoliki itsihskanvtsv'i.
tsiluhsilhhminho thaline uniluhtse'i; utvnvnho-tikalawihstiyi etohe'i v kvwaluhtse'le nunikvwiyusv atsilv-anelhohi, ale tinowhelihski, ale tinilawiki,
ale hi'a nikvwawehsele'i, kato tsahlskahstohti hi'a nahski tsinhahtvneh?  al kako tshanele nahski hi'a itsatvnhtiyi?
tsihsanho unetsv hi'a nituwehsele'i, ayv nahski hsutaleki tvtsvyathvtvnhi, ale hskinohvhsi, ayvnho tatsvnonheli nuhstv akwalhskahstotv hi'a nahski tsinikatvneha.
tsani tsitatawohskvki, kalvlahsko tsutalenhe'i v yvwikwokhe anehv'i?  skinohvhsi.
unvhsvnho kehsv unalhinohelhe'i, hi'a nuniwese'i'i iyunho kalvlati nvtayutalenhvhi yikatvnhv, hi'a ynikawi, katonho lha yetsohiyune'i?
iyuno yvwikwo anehv yikatvnhv,^nahski tanihska'ihe yvwi v nikatvhyenho yvwi atolehohski utohiyuhi kvwayelvha tsani.
uninhetsvno hi'a nuniwehsele tsihsa, vlha yotsikhthaha.  tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehsele'i, vlha nahskwo ayv yvtatsvnonheli iyuhsti akwalhskahstotv hi'a nahski tsinikatvneha.

ulenvhenho tuwonhthane talhilohstihskv'i.ai khilo iyuhsti thelvlti tuwhihse'i, ale uhsoyhile kvwathuwhitv, ale uhskohse kikake-atithahsti kolhvhtiyi i ale unhehskehe inv ikathi, ale tutholhsthane tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi, ale' inv wulohse'i.
unvnhihstiyinhowikehsv iyu'iai unvhse unvhsitahsti tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi tinehv'i, nahski tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi nvtakvwanehtiyi unhehkwotsvhi thelvlati tawhihsvhi.
ikvwaniyvhenho, ale ikvwali'vnhile'i, ale ahsvha ikvwanhikihsthane'i.
thalinenho nvwatale unvhsitahsti unvhse tinehv'i v nahskinho nvyakwo tokvwansthane'ihv ale ikvwahsonvnhe' ahskholi, ale ikvwanhikihsthane utehohihsti ikvwanelvhi.
thalinenho nvwatale unvhse'i; ale nahski unilhe'i i ale unitsathe nvwanatle'i; ikatv tanili'vnhihi, ikatvnho tanihihe'i.
ahsinoh sakwo uwetsi' ehe'i, ukeyuhi, nahski nahskwo unvhse onhiyi tinehv'i, hi'a nuwehse'i, ahse tvnilvkwthani akwetsi.
ahsenho nahski na tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi, hi'a nitunatawehsele'i, hi'a nahski tsukvwalhti wuthiyelihihsti kehsv'i;  kha, etilukahi tsukvwalhthinho uthiyehti ikatselika kehsehsti.
kvwaniyvhvnho kvwalhe'i, ale thelvlati tawhihsv toyititlv wikvwata'invhse'i.
katonho nahski tvtvneli thelvlati tawhihsv utselika? v takaluhtsi ale totvthvhthani nahski tlokesi tsunilvwhihstanehi, ale nvwanatale totvnheli thelvlati tawhihsv'i.
tlahskonho yitsikoliyeo hi'a nahski tsinikvnhv tsikowhela?  nahski nvya, tinanhehskehski uniyo'ihselvhi nukvwiyuhsv unhvhsiyv ahti nulhsthanv;
nahski hi'a yihwa nutvnelv, ale uhskwaniktiyu tetakhanihskv'i.
unanelhthanenho kvwaniyhtiyi, ahseno unitsathi yvwi tanihska'ihe'i; anikhthaheyenho unvhsv ketsitvkv nhahski tulhilohsthanv'i; ikvwatanvelenho ale tunenvhse'i.
tuninvhsenho wikvwalutsehtiyi khilo iyunahsti anikwalihsi ale elotv kvwahstelihski, unihsatvtiyi' unatulihske kawonihskv'i.

uniluhtsvnho, hi'a nikvwawehsele'i, thateyohvhski, otsikhthaha tuyukhtv hiwonihskv kehsv'i, ale khilo nithenayehskvna kehsv'i; vtlayhehno nunahstv yvwi yithelvkwto'i, unelanvhihskini unvnhv utohiyuhsv tehateyhohvhsko'i; tuyuhktihsko ayelhi anakhuyihskv hsihsa akuyv'ehtiyi, tlakhe?
tayotsinhitsu, lhahkhe yvtayotsinhi?vi ahsenho akhthahe unatlonahstv'i, hi'a ntuwehsele'i, katonho ihskkoliyeha?  ehskivhsi akihsi tsukvwalhti' nahski akikowhahthvhtiyi.
uniyolhenho.  hianho nituwesele'i, kako hi'a takatlilohsti, ale kako atsinoheha hi'a tsikawhela? v sihsa, ikvwohsele'i.
tsihsanho unhetli hi'a nsuwehsele'i, sihsa etsakuyvhsi hsihsa utselika, unelhanvhino unelhanvhi utselika.  ikvwahskwanikohselenho.
nokwale anihsatuhsi ikvwaluhtsele'i, nahski ayohuhsv vlha tilehihsohti yiki anatihski; ale ikvwahthvtvnhe'i, hi'a nuniwehse'i.

thateyohvhski, mohsi okowhelanelvki hi'a nokiwehselvki, analinvtli khilo ayohuhskehstihv ale utali'i ikakhahiyahskehstiai tsuwetsinho nitikakhahiyahskvna ikehsehsti, analhinvtli' ayhanihskehsti utali'i, ale nahski analhinvtli tsuwetsi tatvhihstanehehsti.
nahskinho kalhkwoki analhinvtli anehvki;vi ikvyhihnho ehi utehsvnhvki, ale uyohuhsvki tsuwetsi nanehvna.
thalinenho wehi nahski utayhvhsvki, ale uyohuhsvki; nahskwonho nahski' vlha tsuwetsi yituwekhahiye'i; ale nahskiya nhskwo tso'ine wehi.
ale nahski kalhkwoki iyanitv unatayhvsvki, ale vlha yitunihkhahiye tsunetsi v onhyinho akeyhv nahskwo uyohuhse'i.
tsuniyohuhsvhinho tsunalehihsohti kehsv'i, nahiyu nahski hi'a tanalehihsanhvha, kako utalii kehsehsti nahski hi'a?  kalhkwokihyenho iyanitv anatayehvki.
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki, tlahsko yitsilitahstiha, yinvtikalhstohtiha nitsolhkvna kehsv kowheli, ale unelhanvhi ulhiniktiyu kehsv'i?
nahiyuhyenho tsunalehihsohti kehsv tsuniyohuhsvhi, vlha yitanatehsvhvhsko'i, vlha ale yitiketsiyeko'i;  kalvlatihskini anehi ketsinvhsitahsti nunahstv nahskiya nunhsti.

tsuniyohuhsvhinho nahski tsunalehihsohti kehsv'i; lhahsko yitsikoliyeo mohsi utseli kowhelihi, nahski uweyhohtatv unelhanvhi ulhinohehthanv'i, hi'a nuwehselv'i, ayv akwanelhanvhi ekwahami utselikaav ale akwanelanvhi esiki utselika, ale akwanelanvhi tsekakwi utselika.
vtla tsuniyohuhsvhi unatseli unelhanvhi yiki, tinvnhothskini unatseli unelhanvhi; nahski iyuhsti utsathi itsilitahstiha.
tinowelihskinho kehsv ahsiyvwi' uluhtselv, uthvkanv analhinohehskv'i, ale utolehohsv ohsiyu nuwehsv tunhetselv'i, utvtvnhe'i, kato uhsti utli kalvkwtiyu nikatv tikhanhahwatvhsti kehsv'i?  utvnhe'i.
tsihsa unhetsele hia nuwehselei, utli kalvkwti nikatv tikhanhahwtvhsti kehsv hi'a nahski; hathvkvka ihsili; yihowa ikanelanvhi sakwohiyu yihowa;
ale hikeyuhsehsti yihowa tsanelhanvhi hvhtihskehsti nikhv tsanawhi, ale nikhvtsatanhto, ale nikhv tsatanhthehtiyi, ale nika'v tsalhinikvkv'i.  hi'a nahski wutakonatv'tv kalvkwti tikhanhahwatvhsti.
thalinenho kehsvi, nahskiyakwo i hi'a nahski nuhsti, tsvhsv nitsatakeyusv nahskiya nikeyuhsehsti na'v itihstatala.  vlha nvwatale tikhanhahwtvhsti yaha utli ikalvkwti ehskakwo nahski.
tikowhelihskinho hi'a nuwehsele'i; kha, thateyhohvhski v tuyukhtv nhiwi; sakwokwoyhenho eha unelhanvhi; vlha ale nvwatale yeha nahski uwahsvhiyu;

nahskino akeyhtiy khtohtiy nikhv nawhiyi, ale nikhv atanhthehtiyi, ale nikhv atanhto, ale nika'v nolhinikvkv'i, ale na'v iyunatala uwahsv utakeyuhsv nahskiya ukeyuhtiyi, utli kalvkwtiyu ehskakwo nikatv tikvwanohstv atsilv tikelhstohti, ale alhskohltohti.

tsisanoi ukohv akathanhahai iyuwehsti nuwehsv unhetsv'i, hi'a nuwehsele'i, vlha invhiyu yinitsatvnhahteka unelhanvhi utselikohi kehsv'i.  nahiyunho iyutalenvtv vlha khilo kohuhsti kvwathvtvhti yikehse'i.
tsihsanho unhetsv tateyohvhskv uthvnvtikalawihstiyi, hia nuwehse'i; katonho tinowhelihski kalonetv tewi uwetsi, tsanatihsko'i?
tewiyhenho uwahsv kalvkwtiyu atanhto' uweyhohvhskv hi'a nuwese'i, yihowa hi'a nuwehsele akwatseli ukvwiyuhi v tsikathihsi ititlv tsolhehsti khvnhi ketsskaki titsalahsihtiyi kahskilo nikatsiyvnelvha.
tewiyheno uwasv ukvwiyuhi' ikohseha; katonho tikalhstohtiha uwetsi iki?  unitsathinho yvwi unalihelitsvhi kvwahthvtanele'i.
hianho nituwehsele tateyohvhskv'i, tetseyhtotsehehsti tinowelihski ohsiyu tsuniyehlv tikanvhitv tsunanhuwa'i unetahstiyi, ale ketsiyolihstiyi tikantohtiyi,
ale nukvwiyuhsv tekahskilv tikalawi'ihstiyi, ale nukvwiyuhsv tsunanhtlvtiyi tanalhstayvhvkv'i;
nahski tsitanihsvnheho tsunohsulotsvhi taninelv'i, ale unatlonahstv kohitiyu tsanatatolihstihsko'ihv hi'a nahski utli ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti tikekukotanhti kehsehsti.
tsihsanho uwolhe atelv-tihtiyi tsuyukhti, ale ukohe nanatvnehv yvwi atelv tanihvhskv atelv-tihtiyi; unitsathino tsunenhahi utsathi tanihvhske'i.
khilono' iyuhsti uyo iyutvnhahteki uwohsulotsvhi uluhtsv, tha'li akinuthti iyatanhthehti unhe'i, nahski ayelhi iyatanhthehti ika'i tsiki.
wituyhanvhvnho kvwhstawtitohi, hi'a nituwehsele'i, utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha i hi'a nahski uyo iyutvnhahteki uwohsulotsvhi utli' ika'i ahvka ehskakwo nikatv nahski atelv-titiy tsnhka.
nikatvyhehno utsathi unihv unotsaletv anihvka; nahskihskini-unhikitv kehsv ahvka nikatv' uhv'i, nikatv ulhstelhtohti uhv'i.
kanukohenho utvnv-tikalawi'ihstiyi, ahsiyvwi nahski kvwhstawatitohi hi'a nuwehsele'i v thateyohvhski, khvniykwo na niteuhsti nvya ale'inite'uhsti tatane-lv'i?
tsihsanho unhetsv hia nuwehsele'i, tehikowahthihsko hi'a nahski tsekwa tatanelv'i?  vlha hsakwo nvya khanohiyvhi yikehsehsti ytutahsalhahehsti, nahski nikohvhthanvna yikehsehsti.
oliwayonho uhsahilhv uwolhv'i, utvnvtikalawi'ihstiy atanelv tsuyukhotivh kwita, ale tsimi, ale tsani, ale eniti i unvhsv kehsv kvwahthvtvnhe'i, hia nuniwehse'i,
skinohvhsi, hilakiyu nahski hi'a ntakalhsthani? v ale kato uyelhtv kehsehsti nahiyu hi'a nahski nikatv uliyilohihsti kesv'i?
tsihsanho tunhetshelv, ulenvhe hi'a nuwehse'i, itseyhahthahehsti, lhehsti khilo tsitsilonuhelhi.
unitsathehstiyhenho ayv takwatohstv ani'luhihstihskehsti, hi'a naniwehskehsti v ayv nahski; ale unitsathehsti tanilonuhehskehsti.
itsathvkihskehstinho tanhvwa i ale aninhohelhitohv tanhvwa, lhehsti yitsateyhahthanehehsti v nahskiyhenho ahse iyulhstohti; ulhskwatihstiyihskini kehsv asi kehsehsti.

tsunataletvyheno yvwi totvnalenhi totvnatatluthani v ale ayelhi tekolhvwatihsv totvnatatluthani; ale katohi tahlthelvnhitohehsti, ale takonulohsitohehsti ale uteyhahtohti nikalhsthanitohehstihi hi'a nahski atalenihskv akilhiya.

atina itseyhahthahehsti a tanilawi'vhyenho teketsiyohskehsti; tsunithawihstiyinho tetsilivnhihehsti; ale nunikvwiyuhsateki ale unikvwyuhi aninv tsetsathenhohihsti kehsehsti ayv kesv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, nahski kohiyuhtihski tsunikhthileki.
ohstvnho khanohetv ikvyi nikvnhatv tsunehwatihsv yvwi alhtsitohti kehsehsti.

ale nhhakwo tetsathinhekehstivv ale tetsiyohskehsti, lhehsti ikvyi kayehi yitselihihskehst itsiwehstiyi itsinhe'ihstiyi, ale lhehsti ikvyi kayehi yitsatanhthehskehsti; nuhstvhskini wihiyu kesv etsinelv nahski itsinekehsti; vtlayenho nihi yitsaneko'i v kalvkwtiyuhskini atanhto.
analhinvtlinho tuyohskehsti analhinvtli uyohuhihstiyi; ahskayanho uwetsi tuyohskehstioi ale tikekanvki tanalehvhskehsti tsunikayvlike tanatlutihskehsti v ale nahski nanvnhihsihskehsti teketsihehsti.
ale nikatiyu yvwi ketsihskaki kehsehsti ayv tsukwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti a khilohskini kvlhskwatihski tikhanhahwateki, nahsk atsihstelhti kehsehsti.

itsikowhthihskehstihskini uhska'ihsti athvhtihski tenil atolehohski unhe'ihsthanvhi v katokehsti nanhahkvwaleti nikehsvna, (khilo akoliyehskehsti kolhkehsti,) nhahakw tsutiyi' anini analihsvha ttsotalv wanilohsvha.
ale khilo kahsanali ukhi'lehsti, lhehsti yvtitloskehsti atanelv wiyayvhihehsti v ale lhehsti nanha hwiyyvhihehsti wukihstiyi kohuhst unhahv kanelv'i.
ale khilo tlokehsi etohi lhehsti ytiutsvsehsti unhuwo yunehsolhehsti.
ale uyo'iyu iyunalhstanhehti tininelitv, ale tsunhsta'i nahiyu kehsehsti.
ale itsatatolihstihskehsti itsithayohihehsti kola itsalihstiyi nikehsvn iyulhstohtiyi.
nahiyuhyenho kehsehsti akilhiya' ehehstihi nashki kolhvnhvhi nahsk unelhanvh tsuwolhvnhe nvtakvwatalenhvtv khohi iyahsti vhlha nahski iyuhsti yutenho'i, vlha ale utehti yikehsehsti.
ale ukvwiyuhi nitukolatvna yikehse nahiyu' ika, vlha ukwetalhi yikayetsihstelvhe'i v kekahsuyetvhskini nvtikalhstohtihavv nahski tsuhsuyetv kehsv'i v nahski tukola'tv nahiyu ika.
nhahkwonho' iyu khilo hi'a nitsiwehselvha v khvnhiyukwo anhi kalonetv; ale kvnhiyukwo nanhahni; lhehsti itsohiyunhvki;
kalonetvyhenho unatselvhi ale anatolehohski unatselvhi tvninanukothsihs ale aninanukowhihskehst uyelhtv ale uhskwanikhti, nsk tsnlnuhtiyi, iyunho yeli yiki, nhskwo kekahsuyetv.
nihihskini itseyhahthahehstiuv khvnhiyukwo nikatv nitsvnonhelv.
nahiyuhskini kehsehst, ulohsonhehsti nahski akilhiya v nvto' ika ehi tvhlsihvhsi v ale nvtoh svnoyi' ehi vlha ika yuthehsteti;
ale nokwsi anikhalv kalvlohi aninvko'skehstisi ale unitsathe kalvlo tsanikhala tvnalhthelvnhi.
nhahkwonho tvnikohi yvwi uwetsi tsa'ihsehsti ulokilv'isi unhuwohstehsti utsathi ulhiniktiyu kesv' ale kalvkwtiyu kehsv'i.

nhahkwonho totknvhsi tsutseli tinikhanhahwtitohi, ale totakalhihsanhi kekahsuyetv tsutselika witotvyhanvhi nvhki nitotikalohskv unole, elohi wulhsthinilhv ntayutalenvtv kalvlonho wulhsthinilhv wikaluhki.
itsatelhokwanho hsvkhtha-iyuhsti tluhkv talhilohsthv'i;ai uwanikalhv nhahkwo utake nikalhsta, ale tsikalhstuhvhsko'i v itsikthaho koki navnhiyu kehsv'i;
nahskiya nahskwo nihi, nhahkwo itsikowahthihskehsti hi'a nahski nikalhsthanitohv'i a itsikthahehsti nvnhiyu kehsv'i, kalohihstiyikwo kehsv'i.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseheav hi'a nahski kohi tsaneha vlha yvtvnilohsonhi kvnhi hi'a nahski nikatiyu nikalhsthanvha.
kalvl ale elohi tvnilohsonhi; ayvhskini akhinetsv vlha yvtakalohsonhi.
nahiyuhskini ika kesv ale iyu khalawatihsv vlha khilo yakhthaha, vlha nhskwo tinikhanhahwatitohi kalvlati anehi, lha nakwon uwetsi, akayvlikehskini uwahsv.
itseyhahthahehsti i itsiyahwskehsti ale itsatatolihstihskehsti; vlhayhenho yitsikhthaha iyu kesv'i.

[yvwiyhenho uwetsi] nahskiyakwo ahskaya tsanhikihsko ilvhtlv tseko'i, nahski tsikteko kanelv'i, al anikhthiya tsinitekvnheho tsunhvhsitahsti, ale anihsiyvwiha tsuni lvwihstanhti tsitanheho'i v ale kalohihstiyi akhthiya tsikhanetseho uyahwtiyi.
nahski iyuhsti itsiyawihskehsti; vlhahyeno yitskahthaha iyukwo uluhihstiyi kanela v uhsv'i, ale hsvnoyi ayelhi, ale tsathaka aniyvhkv'i, ale hsunale'i;
yika'luhkiyheno yayelo'ihsta, yvtsiwhahthvhta itsilhina'v'i.
nahskinho hi'a nihi tsinitsvwehseha, nahski nikatvkwo nikatsiwehsehav itsiya'wskehsti.

tha'lino winuhsvlhv khanohiyvki tilhstayvhtiyi ale nakothanhvn katu akihstiyi uhskwalhti kese'i, nunikvwihsvno atsilvanelhohi ale tinowhelihski uniyhole iyuntvnhtiyih kalonuhetv untohtiyi uniniyhtiyi, ale unihihstiyi.
ahsenho vlhehsti tilhstayvhtiy iyu ika kehsv'i v yanahltelvhvkayheno yvwi, unatvnhe'i.

kwetiniyinho etohe'i, awani atayehski utlvtsvhi kanelv'i, kanhvhkenho alihstayvhvhske'i i akeyhv uluhtse ayhehe kuku nvya unekv kolhvhthanvhi atlihste atloneti nata tsutitv, utsathi tsukvwalhtiai ale ulohsv' kukuhi ale ulonethane ahskholi.
khilonho unatahsuye unvyhutse totsunatanhthv'i, ale hi'a nuniwehse'i, katonho hi'a atsewoki atloneti?
yuninatinvhseyhenho nahski hi'a atloneti tso'itskwi anikihsi tsunkvwalhti ulohsvhsti yitulikvwalhane'iav ale uyo iyunatvnhahteki tiknhehti yikese'i.  ale kvwakonelohihsele'i.
tsihsanho ha nuwehse'i, unelaki; ka'tonho i'etsateyahthohtiha?  ohsiyu teulvwhihstasi tsinakwvka.
uyoyhehno iyunatvnhahteki nikohilv ketshelatitohaav ale iyukwo itselihskv'i ohstv yinitetsatvnhihsi i ayvhskini' vtla nikohilv yitsvyelatitoha.
nika'v ikvwatvnhti kesv natvkaav ikvyi kayehi ka'luhki ulonetiyi tsiyele vkinihsohtiy ukvwalhi.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvweseha v ilvhtlv hi'a nashki ohstv khanohetv alhtsitoti nikalhstihskehsti elohi nikvnatv'i, hi'a nahski tsinatvka nahskwo uninheti kehsehsti nahski akanvtatihstohti.
tsutahsinho ihykalati, ahsiyvwi nhski thalatu iyanitv kesv'iai uwenvhse nunikvwiyusv atsilv-anelhi tininv'i, nahski tsuyohihsehtiyi.
unathvkanvnho ohsiyu uniyelvnhe'i i ale unithuhstanele atelv tsuninhehtiyi.  uyholenho ohstv utltanvttehtiyi tsuyohihsehtiyi.
ikvyyn ika nahkthanvna katu akihstiyi, nahiyu unilhv khanohiyeki tilhstayhtiyi, kvhwstawtitohi hi'a nikvwawehsele'i, hatlv tsatuli' wokatvnv'ihstohtiyi, khanohiyeki tsalhstayvhtiyi'?
tunvhsenho anithali kvhwstawatitohi, ale hi'a ntuwehsele'i, tikatuhv ihstena, totatsatlohshinho ahskaya ayhehehsti athelito' ama atlihstehsti; ehstihstawatesvha.
ilvhitlnho wayvlhvha, hi'a nehstiwehselvha ahskaya kanela, titeyohvhski hi'a nikaweha, hatlv anetohi uniyvhstiyiav nanhahkhanohiyek itsulaha okalhstayvhtiy kvkihstawatitohi.
tahstahsehelinho uthvnv kalvlati khanvhsulv'i, kayula kvnhahi, al atvnv'ihsthanvhi; nanha hskiyatvnv'ihstanelvha.
kvwhstawatitohinho unenvhse' ale tikatuhv wuniluhtse'i i ale wuniwhahthvhe nahskiya nituwehselv'i; unatvnv'ihsthanenho khanohiyeki tilhstayvhtiyi.
uhsvno nulhsthanv uluhtse tathenehe tha'lat iyanitv.
nahskino aninvhlhatai ale analhstayvhvhske'i, tsihsa hi'a nuwehse'iav utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha, ahsiyvwi hi'a tsinitsatvnhv itsulaha tsohstalhstayvhvhska, tvkwatluthani.
unalenvhenho uyo uniyelvnhe'i, ale hi'a nikvwwehsele'i, sakwo kvwesvtv, tsiko ayv?  nvwatalenho, tsiko ayv?  atihske'i.
unhetsvnho hi'a ntuwehsele'i, ahsiyvwi thaltu itsitv kehsv nahski itsulaha athelitokihi tsohstahsuwhahska.

yvwi uwetsi utohiyuh uwenvhsti nahskiya nikvnhv kowhelv atsinohehskv'i; ahsenho uyo'iyu iyulhstanehti nahski ahskaya yvwi uwetsi atlutihski!  ohsiyu yikehse iyunho nahski ahskaya nutenhvnakwo yikehse'i.
analihstayvhvhskvnho tsihsa katu ukihsv i ale ulihelitsv, ukvhaluyhe'i, ale tunhele'i, ale hia nuwese'i i itsiki, itsika; hi'a nahski' ayv tsiyelv'i.
ale ulihskwiti ukihsv v ale' ulihelitsv, nahski tunhele'i v nikatvnho nahski unatithahe'i.
han nituwehsele'iai hi'a nahski ayv akikikv itsv khanohetv tatlohihstv'i i nahski unitsathi tsikekatsewelv.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha, vlha nhahkwo ilvhiyu yvkakatitha thelvlati unanukowhihsvhihv khvnhi nahiyu ika itse katithahvha unelhanvhi utselikohi.
tuninhokihsvnho, uninukotse oliwayo' otalv wunilohse'i.
tsihsanho hi'a ntuwehsele'i, nitsi'v nihi totatsotelhi kohi hsvnoy tsikihi ayv kehsv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti; hi'ayheno nikvnh ikowhela, awhi tikahthiya tatsiyvnili, uninotenanho tvnatikaleyotsi.
ahsenho nhahkwo tikwalenhvhi kehsehsti, ikvyi tatsvyenv'eli kelili iyvtv.
ahsenho kwita ha nuwesele'i, nahskwo nikatv yitunotehsthanv, ayv ahse vlha.
tsihsano hia nuwehsele'i'i utohiyuhya hi'a nikvwehsehaav nahski khohi ika v ale kohikwo hsvnoyi v ahsi thaline naniyvhkvna tsathaka, tso'i nvtahskwatahyili.
ahsenho utli ulhinikitv unhetse hia nuwehse'i, iyunho nahskwo itsulaha tikiniyohuhihsti yiki v ahse' vlha yvkakvyatayika.av nahskiya nahskwo nuniwehse nikatv.
kesemininho tuto'v uniluhtse'i v hi'anho nituwehsele kvwstawatitohiav anhi itsinehsti v wiktatolihstihskv ikohitv.
tuthenhvhsenho kwita ale tsimi ale tsani v ale ulenvhe utsathi uteyhahthanele'i, ale utsathi ehihsti utanvhthate'i;
ale hi'a ntuwehsele'i, akwatanhto utsathi uteyhahthaneha ayohuhihsti nahskiya'i; anhi' itsinehsti, ale itsiyahwskehsti.
uhstikitvnho iyvtv i'uwenv, elati utanvne'i i ale utatolihsthane', uhthayolhe'ihi nahski yeli ikvwalhstohti yiki i nahiyu khsv ulohisehtiyikwo.
ale hia nuwehse'i, akwa, etota, nihi, kehsv' yelikayakwo iketsatvnhti nika'v'i; skihvhsikwo hi'a nahsk ulihskwiti; vtlahskininonv ayv akwatulihskv'i, nihihskini tsatulihskv'i.
i'uluhtsenho ale tuwahthvhe anilhinae'i, ale hia nuwehsele kwita v sawani, hilhihakwotsu?  tlahsko hsulhilotvkwo ikohitv nahskwo ketsayawhihsti yikehse'i?
itsiyahwskehst ale itsatatolihstihskehsti nahski lhehsti utalenahstiyi witsinnkotsvki; atanhto utohiyuhi utvnv'ihsti, ukwetalhvhskini awanakalahiyu.
thalinenho iyvtv wulosv, utatolihsthane'i v nuwesv' nahskiya winuwese'i.
ti'uluhtsvnho tuwahthvhe tha'line anilhinaihv tinikhtholihyehno tikaktiyu kehse'i, vtl ale yinikhthahe iyuniwehstiy uninetshehtiyi.

tso'ineno wituluhtsele'i v ale hi'a nituwehsele'i, ketsilhinehstikwo nhahkwo i ale itsatsawehsolvhsta; nhahkwo kalohson-nhahakwo ahskwalv nahiyu kehsv'i; kvnhiyukwo yvwi uwetsi anihskana teketsiyohihsi.
titsalehvka, itena v khvnhiyukwo akwatlutihski ehskanhiyu taya'i.

khilakwono' iyvtv ahsikwo kawenihske'i v tsunalvkotse, tsutasi, ahsiyvwi thalatu iyanitv kehsv' v tathinehe unitsathi, ayelhsti-tikanvhit al at tininehi v nvtakvwaninvhsitv nunikvwihysv atsil-anelhohihv ale tinowelihski, ale tinilawiki.

utlutihskino kvnikehsv itsuwanhelvhi kehse unatolehohihstotivi hi'a iyuwehsvhi kehse'i, khilo tsiyathutsalhanvha v nahski kehsehsti, svtsiniyvhvha, etsathinhawitvhvha kvwatutalehsti nikehsvn netsvnehsti.
uluhtsvkwonho khilakwo iyvtv wuluhtsele'i, ale hia nuwes, htiskwyhski, tihskweyhohvhski; ale uthutsalhane'i.
tekvwahsihthatenho', ale kvwaniyvhe'i.
ahsiyvwinho nav anitonhahi, ayelhsti-kanvhitv ulvhe'i, ale nukvwyuhsv atsilv-kelhohi unvhsitahsti uluyhe' ale ulihstehsthane'i.
tsihsano unetsv hi'a ntuwehsele'i v tsiko kanohskihski tsvtsetsiniyvhihso nahskiya itsi'luhki, titsinehi ayelhsti-tikanvhitv ale ata ayv hskiniyvhoka?
nitukitsvnhihsv' itsvyelatitohvki uthvnv-tikalawihstiyi, tekateyohvhskvki, ale vlha yihskiniyvhe'i; utohiyuhtihskininonv nikvnhv kowhelv'i.
nikatiyunho kvwahtetshone'i e ale unalihse'i.
khilono iyuhsti awinv uhstawatvhse'i v tholetv anhuwo utakwenvhte uyelvha kehsv'i i aniwinvnho kvwaniyvhe'i.
toletvnho anhuwo uniye'i, ale uyelvha tulihthi'ele'i.
tsihsano nukvwihysv atsilv-kelhohi tsuwolhv wunathinvhsthane'i; nahskino tekvwalawi'e nikatv nunikvwiyuhsv atsilanelhohi v ale tinilawiki, ale tinowhelihski.
kwitano ke iyvtv uhstawatihse'i, nahski nukvwiyuhsv atsilv-kelhohi tikanhelv wuyvlhe'i, uwolhenho ktsinvhsitahsti ani'nv'i v ale kothv ukanawohske'i.
nunikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv-anelhohi ale nikatv tanilawi'v uniyhohe uninhelhvhi tsihsa utlutihski, nahski unihihstiyi, unatlohtsenho.
unitsatheyhenho kayhkoki aninhohehski kvwatlutihske'i, ahseno aninhohehskv vlha ulhoyi yikehse'i.
tunalenheno khilo iyunahsti ale kayhkoki uninhohelhe kvwatlutihskv'i, hi'a naniwehske'i;

okatvkanvki hi'a nikhawehskvki, tatsiyohsthani hi'a uthvnv-tikalawihstiyivi nahski tikoyi tikhthanvhi kolhvnhvhi, tsoikwonho tsuhsvhitv tvtsiylitoli tvkanehskehi nvwatale tikoyi tikhthanvhi nikehsvna.
ahsenho nahskwo nahski uninhohelhi vlha ulhoyi yikese'i.
nukvwiyuhsvnho atsilv-kelhohi ayelhi ulenhvyv uhtvtvnhe tsihsa, ha newehse'i, tlahsko kohuhsti yatiha?  kato nahski hi'a tsaninhoheha ketsatlutihskv'i?
ahsenho elhawekwo uwahse'i, ale' vtla kohuhsti yutvnhe tsvnhetse'i.  nukvwiyuhsvnho atsilv-kelhohi thaline uthvtvnhe, ale ha nuwehsele'i v nihihsko kalonetvai atsilvkwoti uwetsi?
tsihsanho hi'a nuwese'i v ayv nhahski; ale tayetsiko'i yvwi uwetsi uwolhehsti akhthihsi' ititlv ulhinikitv kehsv'iyv ale tsa'ihsehsti ulokilv kalvlo'i.
nukvwiyuhsvno atsilv-kelhohi tunhuwa'v tuwetsakalvhe'ivi hia nuwese'i, katonho' ahsi yitikatuli aninohehski?
itsathvkvka ahsotlv'ihstihskv'i i kato itseliha?  nikatvnho tekvwukhtanele yelikwo kvwayohuhihsti kehsv'i.
ikatvnho unalenvhe tekvwaltsiskwske'i, ale ukhathv kvwulhvnehe'ihi ale ahskwinhv tekvwanitihske'i, ale hi'a nikvwwesehe'i, hatolehohi; ale ketsinvhsitahsti tekvwanhihe'i.
kwitanho elatitlv nanhahatanelv etohe'i, uluhts hsyvwi akeyhv nukvwiyuhsv atsilv-kelhohi unvhsitahsti.
nahskinho ukohv kwita ukanawohskv'i v tukhanhahne'i, ale hia nuwese'iav nihi nahskwo tsihstetohvki tsihsa nahseliti ehi.
ahsenho utayhile'i, hi'a nuwesi, vlha yitsikathaha, vlha ale yikolika niwehskv'i.vi unhukotsenho toyititlv wayotalhahv wulohse'ivi tsathakanho uyvhlse'i.
athvnho thaline ukohe'i, ale ulenvhe hi'a nituwehsele na'v anitona'i a hi'a nahski nanhahkhela.
thalineno uthyili.  nikohilvna'nho ohni nahski na'v anitona'i thaline hi'a nuniwehsele kwita, utohiyuhi nihi nanhahhela v keliliyheno hehi, ale kowonihskv ulhoy iki.
ahsenho ulenvhe uhskinvte ale uhselithane hia newese'i, vlha yitsikathaha na ahskaya nahski tsetsinoheha.
thalinenho uyvlhse tsathaka.  kwitanho untate tsihsa nuwehsv'i, hi'a tsinuwehsele'i i ahsi tsathaka tha'li nuyvlhsvna kehsehstihs tso'i nvtahskwatayili.av nahskinho utanhthelhv tutloyhile'i.

kilakwonho' iyvtv wukitsvnv nunikvwiyuhsv atsil-anelhohi, ale tsunathvhsonhvhi, ale tinowelihski, ale nikatv tinilawiki unalhinohelhv unalhvle tsihsa, ale  unhthinhawitvhe'i, ale kwaleti wituniyohihsele'i.
kwaletinho utvtvnhe hia nuwehsele'i, nihihsko tsakvwiyuhi anitsuhsi unatselika?  unhetsvnho hi'a nuwehsele'i, yelikwo nhiwi.
nunikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv-anelhohi utsathe tsutalenhvtv kvwuhihstihske'i.
kwaletinho thaline uthvtvnhe hi'a nuwese'i; thlahsko kohuhsti yatiha?  khvnhiyukwo utsathi tsutalenhvtv aninhoheha ketsatlutiha.
ahsenho tsihsa ahsi' vlha kohuhsti yatihske'i; nahski iyuhsti kwaleti uhskwanikose'i.
tanalhstayvhvhskvnho iyu'i tayohihsehe ahsiyvwi ayhvkhi, nahskikwo anithayoha.
ahsiyvwhinho ehe kwalakwa tsuto'itv nahski itsulaha tekekalv'e kvwalikonhelvhi unatahsuyetv unalhthelvnhvhi, nahski unatalhvhi kehse nahiyu unatahsuyetv unalhthelvnhv'i.
unitsathinho ahstaya unalhihste'i, unalenvhe unithayolhe nahskiya nitutvnhelv tsuwakhthanvhsv itsutvnhehtiyi.
kwalehtinho tunhetshele hi nuwehse'i, itsatulihsko ukvwiyuh anitsuhsi unatselik tiyuyohihsehtiyi.
akhthaheyhenho nahski nunikvwiyuhsv atsil-anelhohi anvyutshehvkwo nvtikalhstohtihskv tekvwayohsvhi.
ahsenho nunikvyuhsv atsil-anelhohi nunvnhihsanhe unitsathi yvwi, nahski kwalakwa unithayohstiyi tsuyohihsehtiyi.
kwaletino thaline unetsv, hi'a nituwehsele'i, katonho itsatuli tsiynhtiyi nahski na ukvwiyuhi anitsuhsi unatselika tsetsoseha?
thalinenho unelhunhe'i hiyatv'vka unatvnhe'i.
kwaletno ha nituwehsele'i, katonho, kato uhsti uyo tulvwhihstanelv?  ahsenho utlikwo iyahstaya unelhunhe'i, hiyatv'vka, unatvnhe'i.
kwalehtinho ohsiyu uyelvse ohstv tsutanhtatihstohtiyi unitsathi, tuyohihsele kwalakwa, tsihsanho uli'vnhilv tuyohse akatvtiyi.
aniyahwskinho kvwahthinhawitvhe wikvwayhthane ukvwiyuhiyi atanelv'i nahsk ukvwiyuhi tstsilawitshehtiyi, nikatvnho hsunatahlhuhki wituniyanvhe'i.
kikakenho kvwhanhuwe'e'i, ale alhstulo tsutsayohsti kolhvhthanvh unihsteyonhv, nahski unihstulothane'i.
ale unalenvhe aniyolihe'i, itsvyolika, tsakvwiyuh anitsuhsi unatselika, anatihske'i.
ahskholinho tekvwanhihe kanhsta kvht, al tekvwalitsiskwske'i, ale tanalhnikwanv'vhske kvwatatolihstanehe'i.
unatehohthannvnho, kvwanhuwehse kikake'i, ale uwahsv tsunhuwo tekvwhanhuwo'e'i, ale wikvwahthinhvhsthane kvwatvtiyi.
khilono' iyuhsti hsawani tsuto'itv hsalini ehi a'ihse'i, totikalokehsv nvtayulohsvhi, nahski eliki ale lukwahsi unitota, nahsk utseli tsutanhahwatv uwenvhstiyi nunvnhele'i.
kolikatanho tuto'v wikvwahthinhvthane'i, nahsk anhelhthanvhi kehsv uhskwaluko katka.
kwanenhelenho utithahsti kikakeatithahsti mila ahsuli; ahsenho' vlha yunekise'i.
nhahkwonho tatanhahwhstv kvwatvnv uniyatholhe tsunhuwo'i, unahsehsvhe unatolehohihstiyi nahski anihsiyvwiha tsuninehsvhsti kehsv'i.
sonhelanho iyulhilotv khalawatihsv kese'i, ale khvwatvne'i.
kalvlatitlvnho kowhele nuhstv aku'ihstv'ivi hia nikvnhe'i, ukvwiyuhi anitsuhsi unatselika.
itsulahanho tekekatvne anithali tinatanahsa'hvhski; ahsiyvwi akhthihsititlv, sohno akhskani ititlv.
kowhelvnho utohiyunhe'i, hi'a tsinikaweha, unihskanvtsvhi kekahselhv aklhoyahsthanvki.
anilohskino kakvwahsolhtihske'i, ale tanalhstvnhihe hia naniwehske'i, yo, uthvnv-tiklawihstiy hiyohstihski, ale tso'ikwkwo ika hihyilitoh hanhehskehski,
tsvhsv halihstelv, ale ehatlahi tatanhahwahstv'i.
nahskiya nahskwo nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv anelhohi ale tinowhelihski kvwatehohtihskv, hi'a nitanatawesehe'i, nvwanatale tahstelihskvki; uwahsv' vlha yvkvlhstelv.
kalonetv ukvwiyuhi ihsili unatselika nhahkwo watlahi tatanhahwhstv'i, nahski okikowhahthvhtiyi ale okohiyuhtiyi.  ale nahski itsulaha tikekatvnvhi kakvwahsotlvhte'i.
thalatunho iyulhilotv ulhiyilolhv ulhsihvhse nikvnathv nanhahkatohihv tso'i iyulhilotv iyahsthi.
tso'ine iyulhilotv ulhyilolv tsihsa ahstaya uwelhunhe'i, ha nuwese'ihi ilo'i, ilo'i, lama sakwatani?  nahski anhelhthanvhi hi'a nuhsti kathka, akwanelhanvhi, akwanelhanvhi, katon vskwteki?
ikatnho na'v anitona'i unathvkanv, hi'a nuniwese'i, kvnhiyukwo, ilaya ayhaniha.
ahseyvwinho tuhskwalhthanv, ale tuwoli tsunitsoyhsti wukhali'ihsthanv, ale kanhstohi uwekwathanv, unenhelv utithahsti; hia nuwehse'i, unelaki, itatolehohi, tsikon ilaya takaluhtsi tayutlothanilhi.
tsisano 'staya uwelhunhv, ulhskwatele'i.
ayehtoltvthno uthvnv-tikalawihstiyi ka'tv utatsakalvhe tha'li nutate'i, kalvlati nvtayutalenhvhtv elati wahsthi.
ahskohitskwinho tithinitohi a'ititlv tsuyukhti katoki, utolhohsv nahski uwelhunhv'i, ale ulhskwatelv'i, hia nuwehshe'i, utohiyuhi hi'a ahskaya unelhanvhi uwetsi kese'i.
anikeyhvnho nahskwo ke iyvtv totinikhanhe'i; nanhahno anele meli sukiteli' ehi, ale mel tsimi uhsti' ale tsosi unitsi'i, aleh salomi.
nahski nahskwo kelili tsetohe kvwahstawatitohe' ale kvwahstelvhitohe'i; ale unitsathe nvwanatale anikeyhv tsiluhsilmi nvtakvwahstawatolhvhi.
nhahkwonho uhsv nulhsthanv, nahski atvnv'ihstohtiyi kehsv iyuhsti, nahski unatotakwitena ika kesv'i.
tsowa alimatiyi ehi atsilvkwoti tikalawiki, nahski nahskwo akhthiye unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv uluhihstiyi, nahski uluhtse'i, ale nahska'ihvna wuyvlhe kwaletiyi, ale uhthayole tsihsa ayelv'i.
kwaletinho uhskwasikose utlathsithvehe natlekhv uyohuhsv'i; wuyhanvhvnho hskohitskwi tithinitohi, uthvtvnhe, yelihsko kohiki kvwayohuhsvhi, utvnhehi.
kvnikehsvno nuwanelv hskohitsukwi tithinitoh, tsowa tuyohihsele ayeli.
uwhahsvnho uhsitolhi tholetv anhuwo, ale utesv ayelv'i, ale anhuwokihi tholetv uwetsanulanv, atselihstv unvne naski nvyohi ahskosvhi, ale nvya uwehsakwalelhe'i atselihstv kalohihstiyi unhe'i.
melinho makiteli ehi, ale meli tsohsi utsi unikohe nanhahuninvnv'i.
unatotakwahskvnho ulohsonhv, meli makiteli ehi, ale meli tsihmi utsi' aleh salomi uniwhahsvhi kese ukanahstv kawhsvki, uniluhihstiyi uniyelvhse ale kvwalonetiyi.
sunaleiyunho ikvyiyi ika hsunatotakwahsti kehsv'i, uniluhtse atselihstv tsvtikhalvkokwo.
hi'ano nitunatawehsele'i, kako takihv'eli nvya atselihstv' kalohstiy ahv'i?
witunakhanhahanhvno unikohe nvya ahvtv kesvhi v utsathiyeno ekwohiyu kehse'i.
wuniyvlhvnho atselihstv'i, unikohe awiyv akhthihsititlv uwolhe'i v unhuwe kanvhitv unekv anhuwo; anihska'ihenho.
hano nituwehsele'i, lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti; tsihsa nahseliti' ehi etsiyohahi nahski tsakatv'vhskvki; tulehihsanhv; vlha anhi yika'nvhi titsakhanhvka a  uninvnv'i.
ahsenho tsitsenaav ale wititsinohvhsi kvwhstawatitohi ale kwita nahski ikvyi witulohihsehtiyi kelili; nanhhtayetsiko'i, nahskiya nitsiwehselv'i.
ulhihstinho uninukotsv tunalithehse atselihstv'i; tuninawihskeyhenho ale unihskwanikohske'i; vlha ale khilo kohuhsti yunohsele'i; anihska'iheyhenho.
tsihsano tulehihsanv hsunaleiyu ikvyiyi ika hsunatotakwahsti kehsv'i, ikvyi khnikesv nutvnhele meli makiteli' ehi, nahski kalhkwoki anihskina tsitunkowhihsele'i.
nahskino uwenv unetolvhi witunonhele uyo tunatanhthv'i ale tanatloyhihv'i.
nahskinho unathvkanv kvnhv'i, ale nahski ukohvhi, vlha yunohiyunhe'i.
onhino nvwatale nuhste khvnikehsv nitutvnhele anithali nanhahanhela ana'ihse'i, totikalokehsv wanikhthe'i.
nahskino unenv wituninhonele anihso'i; nahskwo' vlha' yitunohiyunhe nahski.

onhinho kvnkehsv nitutvnhele hsatu iyanitv analhstayvhvhskvihi ale tukvhskolvne nikalhstohtihske nunohyuhsvna kehsv ale tihstayiyu kehsv tsuninawhi, ntunohiyuhnvna kehsv iyuhsti nahski kvwakohvhi tsulehsanhi nikehse'i.
hianho nituwehsele'i, itsetna elohi nikvnathv'i, ale wititsalhtsitohvhsi ohstv khanohetv nani'v kekolhvnhvhi.
khilo kohiyuhvhskehsti ale akawohskehsti atsihstelhti kehsehsti a nikohiyuhskvnahskini tsakukotanehti kehsehsti.
hi'an nhski uyelhtv tikolhihstohti tha'li tuttitekehsti anohyuhvhski; ayv takwato anhtihskehsti anihskina taninukowhihskehsti v nvwanatale tsuniwonihihsti taniwonihskehsti;
inatv taninheskehsti v iyu ale kohuhsti atahihi yunatithahv, vlha kohuhsti yunvnehehsti; tsunitlvki tanahsihthatihskehsti, ale tunatiwhskehsti.
nahskinho ukvwiyuhi tuwonhthanv i kalvlati totsatetanilvtse'i, ale akhthihsi ititlv unelhanvhi uwolhv uwenhe'i.
unenhvhsenho ale nikvnathv unahltsitonhitole'i, ukvwiyuhi thali utvhtiteke tunilvwhihstanehv'i, ale aninhekv ahstaytihstske uyelhthv ullhoyahstitehkv'i.  emenv.
